user_reviews.Name: runningdogyankee
user_reviews.Description: Seems like a nice place to hangout during the day for access to the ocean. We had drinks in the early evening and then left before the whole neighborhood descended into teenybopper party weekend and traffic jam nightmare.

user_reviews.Name: Nyota ya Africa
user_reviews.Description: If you spend time here, you can go swimming or serving. There are sunbeds, so you can relax before and after swimming! There is a shower inside the bathroom, so you can change into a swimsuit :) The food is so delicious and it's a great place to relax while looking at the sunny sky! The staff is nice, too!

user_reviews.Name: Alyssa Leggoe
user_reviews.Description: Food is always delicious here and the view can’t be beat! I gave them 4 stars because a bunch of menu items were out of stock - avocado, chicken - which made the menu less interesting.

user_reviews.Name: Aida Sall
user_reviews.Description: I am really sad that I’m writing this because this this part has been my favorite in a while. I’ve been coming to la plagr every single time I come over dakar since 2018 but recently the management has went to shit. The new waitresses are really, really rude. I had an incident where I accidentally broke my glass and I was met with such such rudeness when I’ve been A loyal client for years. I hope the owner sees this and takes care of the management because this spot the nicest. They have a really good chef. The food is exquisite. It’s just that the service has really really gone bad now which wasn’t the case before.

user_reviews.Name: Lydia Hickman
user_reviews.Description:
La Plage is one of my Dakar staples. It was my favorite restaurant for a while, but in recent times it’s become less consistent. Lately, they almost never have the full menu, which is quite annoying at times. Also, we’ve stopped getting the “planche Carnegie” because the kitchen just never cooks the meat medium rare no matter how much we insist (and we’ve insisted a TON). It’s always well done.

But I love that you can actually access the beach. There are other items that are quite tasty (pavé de capitaine, the ceviche with mangos, the bruschetta - when they have it - etc.) And the drinks are my fav in Dakar. Benjamin the barman is excellent and never disappoints, so I keep coming back!

user_reviews.Name: Tifani Dyson
user_reviews.Description: Good service and good food, including the steak and fish! Just be advised that the night menu and day menu are different. It would be 5 stars but the flies take away from the experience.

user_reviews.Name: Herman Du Plessis
user_reviews.Description: Nice little restaurant right on the coast, we had a work get together here, the food was great and the hosts very friendly.

user_reviews.Name: ouissam merbahi
user_reviews.Description: Nice place to hang out and spend very good quality time. Recommended

user_reviews.Name: Kamal Dhami
user_reviews.Description: Good ambiance food is good and staff manners excellent 👍

user_reviews.Name: Shaun Nizar
user_reviews.Description: Very good Food ever tasted , ambience  and service espciallly the DJ ..kudos ..

user_reviews.Name: Thanish Hiranandani
user_reviews.Description: Good ambience and the marketing manager is doing a veryy good job !!

user_reviews.Name: Mukesh Rana
user_reviews.Description: Good

user_reviews.Name: Aïda Seye
user_reviews.Description:
Un super restaurant
La nourriture est très bonne
J’ai adoré

user_reviews.Name: Marie Noël Diadia
user_reviews.Description:
Très bon restaurant 🍴.
Totalement satisfaite 😌

title: Restaurant Korean Arisu
address: soleil café, Cor des Almadies, Dakar, Senegal

user_reviews.Name: Worldwide Reviewer
user_reviews.Description: Amazing food! Big portions. The atmosphere is calm and peaceful. We liked the pork belly barbecue on our table. You can watch K-pop videos all day long here :) Well conditioned. Do not accept cards, only cash.

user_reviews.Name: Josh Jung
user_reviews.Description: I am a native Korean who travels around. When visiting Senegal, I started missing korean food and happened to found this spot. Walking in with little expectation as authenticity is always a struggle abroad, I was completely flabbergasted by the level of authenticity and just how scrumptious the food was. The atmosphere and staff were also very pleasant. When I walked in, I got a warm greeting and a very attentive server. I got to meet Sue who was just an excellent character who was very hospitable! Overall, I would highly suggest this restaurant if anyone craves an authentic and delicious korean meal!

user_reviews.Name: Hazelnut Meg
user_reviews.Description:
The taste really did not disappoint! The fried dumplings are very good. The staff is patient, very polite and friendly and the food was served fast enough. Besides, the free side dishes (which are delicious) make it so that you barely feel the waiting at all. The place is cosy but still very lively. It can get loud when it's a bit crowded which didn't bother me at all (I really enjoyed the energy it brought despite the fact that I usually prefer quieter dining spaces) but it's good to know if you don't enjoy that atmosphere.
I like that they label their best dishes on the menu; it helps with the order, especially if you are not familiar with Korean food. I was really charmed by the call buttons they have on the tables. I find it very original and practical!
Lastly, the meals are definitely quite expensive. However, the taste and portion size really fit the prices overall.
I strongly recommend it and will visit again for sure.

user_reviews.Name: Jan Meijer
user_reviews.Description: Great Korean food in Dakar. Authentic taste of Korea in a Korean-run restaurant. The fact that the place is frequented by the local Korean community as well as Korean tourists is recommendation enough!

user_reviews.Name: Martina de Vries
user_reviews.Description:
Amazing Korean food!
Missed the taste of Korean food after having lived in Korea. In Europe it never tastes like in Korea but here it tastes as if I stepped into Seoul, South Korea!
Lovely space where you can also rent games to play and sing karaoke openly.

(Seems like the menu comes from Korea, prices sometimes still state won while you pay in the local currency.)

user_reviews.Name: Max A
user_reviews.Description:
If you are craving for Korean food and you are in Senegal, hahaha, this is the place. I love their black beans noodles. Love the vibe here. It's cozy. Great service, and it's pretty clean.
They only accept cash here.
We recommend this place.

user_reviews.Name: Wendy
user_reviews.Description: We love Korean food, and we've had mixed experiences in Dakar ever since the amazing Mr Ho left, this was our first time here, and we were surprised how expensive it was, the waiter explained many dishes could be shared between two, we enjoyed the Pajeon (seafood pancake) €18.25 the pork bbq was not great. Service was good, would I return, yes it's a nice location, and I'd like to try some of their soups which looked delicious!

user_reviews.Name: Ian Schwenke
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely delicious food, reasonable prices for the level of effort, unique ingredients, and great taste. Extensive menu as well, and very nice tables and outdoor seating area. Also, they are one of few places with Soju in Dakar.

user_reviews.Name: Malina D
user_reviews.Description:
Absolutely loved ILEA Cafe!! The owners were kind enough to host my university program in for a welcoming event at the cafe as we traveled to Senegal, and we had the most amazing brunch and drinks.

The owners were kind and welcoming to us during our time in Dakar. They took time out of their busy schedules to talk to each of the students and professor in our program to ensure we were having the best time during our travels in Senegal. It’s truly inspiring to see how far this business has come, and I’m excited to see their success thrive in the future.

I highly recommend for everyone to stop by this lovely cafe! 💞

user_reviews.Name: Agina Briggs
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely loved this cafe! The ambiance is beautiful and cozy, with such a warm, inviting vibe. The menu is thoughtful and creative, there is something for everybody honestly! Everything tasted fresh and well-made, my favorite was the chicken taco burrito and the cookies! The staff was welcoming and attentive, and the presentation of the food was just as good as the flavors. (I love a good presentation honey) It’s the perfect spot for brunch, dessert, or just a coffee moment. Highly recommend and I will definitely be back!

user_reviews.Name: Tracy BD
user_reviews.Description:
My family had such a wonderful time at Ilea Café. The food was excellent across the board,
the yassa poulet was flavorful and tender, the fish fatayas were perfectly crisp and delicious, and we really enjoyed the coffees and cookies to finish things off.

As good as the food was, what really stood out was the hospitality. The owners went above and beyond to make us feel welcome, and their warmth made the whole experience even more special. It felt less like dining out and more like being hosted by friends who genuinely care.

Ilea Café is the kind of place you want to return to, not just for the food but for the atmosphere and the people behind it. Highly recommended if you’re in Dakar.

user_reviews.Name: Dhani-Sinaan
user_reviews.Description: Ilea café is THE BEST restaurant in Sénégal!!!! The staff is so warm and welcoming—feels like family. But the food is out of this world and they JUST expanded their menu to include VEGAN OPTIONS!!!! Omg My favorite was their magical Chai Latte, the “In love with the Coco” Smoothie, their Vegan Riz Cantonais, their Vegan Taco Burrito, Vegan Wrap, and their Vegan Oreo Milkshake. I also loved their giant green super salad as it was so hearty, refreshing and nourishing. I think this is the first time I almost couldn’t finish a salad—it was that filling!!!  I will be coming back again, again and again. Jërëjëf  Ilea Café!!!!

user_reviews.Name: Caasi
user_reviews.Description:
I had the pleasure of eating here with my study abroad program and it was such a fun time! ILEA had custom menus with my school’s name which contributed to the warm welcome. I enjoyed the Oh My Gaufre Brunch with a Mango Matcha with Oat Milk. The brunch was so good and was similar to my comfort food of Chicken & Waffles back at home.

I was also able to meet the owners who welcomed my program and have such an enriching conversation about life transitions, professional development, and family. After the lunch and discussion, my program and I stayed at the cafe to watch Senegal win the semifinals. The experience celebrating such a win at ILEA Cafe will be unforgettable. Thank you Ilea Cafe for your welcome & hospitality!

user_reviews.Name: Mariama White
user_reviews.Description: First time at ILEA Café yesterday and wow… loved it! The staff is super friendly, the place is clean, and they’ve got both indoor and outdoor seating. I went for lunch and it was so good I came back for dinner the same day. And this morning? I found myself back again for breakfast… I think I’m hooked on this place! The food is delicious with plenty of options for breakfast, brunch, or dinner, and the coffees + smoothies are next level. All of that for a very affordable menu. Truly a gem in Dakar — 10/10 recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Roberta Liakaite
user_reviews.Description:
Super cute spot for breakfast or brunch. Friendly staff, and if you don't speak any French, there are people who do, so you will be fine!

Food is tasty and definitely make sure you try out their cookies!

user_reviews.Name: James Page
user_reviews.Description:
Just had the most amazing meal at Ilea Café and I’m still thinking about it!
The kebabs were absolutely perfect — juicy, well-seasoned, and grilled just right. Paired with the fried rice and colorful veggies, every bite was full of flavor and freshness.
Their carrot and beet juice was such a refreshing surprise — naturally sweet, vibrant, and super energizing.
And I couldn’t resist the chocolate chip cookie… soft, warm, and loaded with melty chocolate. The perfect sweet finish!
The whole place has this laid-back vibe with comfy seating, cool décor, and beautiful artwork on the walls that make it feel both cozy and creative. 🎨
If you’re ever in Dakar, make sure to stop by Ilea Café — it’s the perfect spot to unwind, eat great food, and soak in the atmosphere. 🌿☕️

user_reviews.Name: Alberto MAYNAR AGUILAR
user_reviews.Description: Fantastic place. A must go in Dakar. Great to swing by the beach nearby and than have lunch in one of the terrass.

user_reviews.Name: Marta Cummings
user_reviews.Description: We had an amazing lunch!! The place has an incredible location, food is good and people is really kind. So great place to enjoy a meal or a drink

user_reviews.Name: Michelle LLC
user_reviews.Description: This is the best place to start your amazing adventure in Ngor. The owners make you feel like family and the staff are amazing! Shout out to the best restaurant hostess and lifeguard that even calmed the babies!!! You are appreciated!!!  Journey off, explore the island and see all the hidden gems. Then come back and cool off with the best jump into to Atlantic and a cocktail! You won’t go wrong here!!!

user_reviews.Name: Igor bętlejewski
user_reviews.Description: Ate grilled calamares and Provence style shrimps with chips. Easily the best calamares I have ever eaten. 5/5

user_reviews.Name: Liz Hixon
user_reviews.Description: The location and view are amazing. The place is not very crowded which is nice. The food is good, but not amazing. I got grilled thiof and my friend ordered gambas. The thiof was cooked perfectly, but wasn’t seasoned as well as other local restaurants. The gambas were a bit dry. However, the staff is quite friendly and accommodating. They didn’t mind my dog laying next to the table. And if you want a dinner with the romance of being on an island, give it a try!

user_reviews.Name: Sean Miller
user_reviews.Description: An outstanding seafood restaurant right on the water on Ngor island. I had the "Blanquette de Lotte" (aka Monkfish stew) which was one of the standout meals I had in Dakar - very fresh, perfect portion size, and delicious!

user_reviews.Name: P.M. Diakhate
user_reviews.Description: Food was delicious and we had a very nice view. It took some time to receive our plates which means it was fresh. Definitely recommend it

user_reviews.Name: ouissam merbahi
user_reviews.Description: Good food. Good view. Staff is smiling and kind. And if you eat there they will provide you a boat to go back to Dakar. Recommended

user_reviews.Name: Chop Stay Love
user_reviews.Description: Secret Spot is a great place to grab a drink and watch the surfers catch waves—super relaxing and low-key. The view is definitely the highlight.

user_reviews.Name: Worldwide Reviewer
user_reviews.Description: Although we did not try any food here, the atmosphere was good. It’s a good place to learn to surf or watch a sunset on the ocean.

user_reviews.Name: Khady Graydon
user_reviews.Description: Great place to surf - learn to surf or watch people surf. The sunset are so beautiful with the surfers riding the waves in the background. There are English speakers there if you speak English. They also speak French and Wolof. I think people speak Spanish as well. The food is good - I love the chicken

user_reviews.Name: Hawken Sawyer
user_reviews.Description: Great vibes. Front row seats to some incredible surfing. Great drinks. Nice people. Will come back!

user_reviews.Name: Jennifer Rōming
user_reviews.Description: My favourite beach bar; best fries in Dakar and try the iced coffee! Wait. No, on second thought, don’t come here and ruin my magical place! 😳 Stay away!

user_reviews.Name: Sara Y
user_reviews.Description: As i haven't eat, i can't advice.. but the place is really beautiful 😍

user_reviews.Name: FPTC Comm 3
user_reviews.Description: If you like surfing and cold beer this is the spot.  The default home of the surfing community in Almadies .  Great place to watch the locals rip and you should get a few 360s when the swell is up. The food is solid and the atmosphere a vibe . Enjoy !

user_reviews.Name: Inês João
user_reviews.Description: Nice spot for sunset. Average drinks, rather expensive and ok staff.

title: SHALUC Taste of India
address: PFRG+CF3 SHALUC Taste of India, Dakar, Senegal

user_reviews.Name: Chandra Ballabh Nautiyal
user_reviews.Description:
We have been to this restaurant for lunch today. I found it one of the best Indian restaurants in Dakar. Delicious food. Deepak and others were very welcoming. I  highly recommend this restaurant to try and give treat to your taste buds.

Keep  it guys. Thank you so much.

user_reviews.Name: Inès Senghor
user_reviews.Description:
Best indian restaurant ever!!
The food is incredibly tasty. I celebrated my birthday with a dozen of friends. We tried a large variety of starters and dishes. Fantastic experience… We all discovered a new taste of India.
The cocktails are also very good.

user_reviews.Name: Games123bado Bado games
user_reviews.Description:
One of the best tables in Dakar! Absolutely stunning and highly underrated.
Food was gorgeous 😍. You can feel the passion and love in every bite.
The place is overall very well decorated with a nice retro fit touch.
Staff is so accommodating, welcoming, and professional.
I highly recommend this spot!

user_reviews.Name: Sumit Sumi
user_reviews.Description: Amazing  experience at shaluc tasteof India restaurant in dakar ,Senegal ! the food  was absolutely  delicious,  fresh ,and full of flavor .the staff was very polite, friendly, and attentive. Service  was quick and professional.  The ambience  was clean , comfortable,  and well  maintained.  Price  are reasonable for the quality  offered . Highly  recommended  for family  and friends.  I will definitely  visit  again!

user_reviews.Name: Sadikh Diene professionnel
user_reviews.Description:
What a delight!
From the moment I stepped in, the aromas, the warm smiles, and the vibrant atmosphere told me I was in for something special. Every dish was a masterpiece — rich, flavorful, authentic, and beautifully presented. The service was attentive without being intrusive, and the ambience perfectly balanced elegance with comfort.

Thank you for bringing a genuine taste of India to Dakar. I’ll be back — and I’m already recommending you to all my friends. Keep shining!

user_reviews.Name: Samba Tine
user_reviews.Description:
Ate here about a month ago and was surprised the place was practically empty!
The food was delicious, and they were really nice. The place is clean and so pretty. We tried a few different things and every dish was amazing.
I hope it fills up! They’re doing something wonderful here, and I’m excited to return.
Honestly really exceptional, especially amongst all the tourist traps

user_reviews.Name: Jaysheel Shah
user_reviews.Description:
Food is top quality.
Service the worst possible. Even below bare minimum.

So basically this is not our first time experiencing the same thing at the same place.
Being indians you know what to expect from an Indian restaurant. First and the most basic is a courtesy of welcoming and table arrangements and all. As we pre-informed the owner before minimum 10 hrs along with the indicated (not fixed) orders, we were expecting that they would be organised with all of that and we were ready to celebrate one of our family members birthday.
Order messed up, inbetween meals waiting time very high, courtesy of explaining 0 , nonchalant behaviour towards us while serving other people in a better yet bare minimum way.
I don't know from last experience we were told to inform before coming basically reserve before coming. This time we expected a lil better from you guys. Thank you, try and improve if you think it is needed

user_reviews.Name: Daphnis Miller
user_reviews.Description: The ambiance is a real success: a modern Indian voyage with an original cuisine full of taste and spices! On top of that, the service is kind and full of care. 5 stars.

user_reviews.Name: Peter Saunders
user_reviews.Description:
Seafood par excellence
This a specialist seafood restaurant in the outer reaches of Dakar but it was on the beach - Senegalese life was in front of you with fishing boats in the distance It is unpretentious but eye catching decor adds to its allure
The service is slow but just sit back and embrace the ambiance and location and let the food speak and it was exceptional.
We had a tartare of dourade with orange and it was quality - fresh flavoursome and and there was effort in its presentation.
We followed that with tiger prawns simply grilled - excellent

user_reviews.Name: World Traveller
user_reviews.Description: Great place on the beach. Can sit outside on benches on the sand or inside if you want more formal setting. Nice view across to Ngor. Friendly staff, good food - filet of fish very good, fish tartar as well. Prices good, nice selection of rums. It’s a meeting place for people to go surfing and fishing so always something going on, relaxed atmosphere. Try it you’ll not be disappointed!

user_reviews.Name: Christina
user_reviews.Description:
I don't say this often but the food was terrible.  If you are looking for any type of flavor or seasoning this is not the place for you.   For an appetizer we had the smoked marlin which was good, but the waiter really sold the Karao (fish) as an entree.  He said it was his favorite and was so delicious, etc.  It was absolutely terrible.  It had no taste (not even salt) and was overcooked.  We will definitely focus on only places with traditional Senegalese food for the rest of this trip.

The only good points would be that dining on the terrace has a nice breeze and you can enjoy the ocean air on the beach.

user_reviews.Name: Lawrence Kay
user_reviews.Description: Fresh fish and shellfish - some of it from tanks inside the restaurant - served simply and well. Lots of seating inside, with outside tables a good spot for beach watching. Ideal before or after a trip to the island.

user_reviews.Name: Ladina Jegi
user_reviews.Description:
We spent five wonderful days in Dakar at La Cabane du Pêcheur. The room was clean and had everything we needed, including a cute balcony. The food and location were excellent. Khalil was very friendly and always very helpful! :)
Since there's a bar next door, it was a bit noisy at times in the evenings, but this didn't bother us too much. We'd love to come back soon!

user_reviews.Name: Patrick Tunkl
user_reviews.Description:
The rooms directly on the beach are big and clean, the whole place so chill, the service and food amazing. Beach Vibes all day long.
Best stay in Dakar!

user_reviews.Name: Tariro Mlanda
user_reviews.Description: Definitely a place worth visiting. We had cray fish here. Absolutely delicious. You choose your own cray fish from their in-house boat. They weigh it for you and cook for you while you wait. You can also go fishing and bring in your catch and they will cook it for you at a fee and add sides for it. The service was good and the atmosphere was excellent. I mean so long as the beach is by your side and withing your view and reach,how can the atmosphere not be perfect.. Quite a gem and place worth visiting in Dakar.

user_reviews.Name: Chop Stay Love
user_reviews.Description:
La Cabane du Pêcheur is one of those easy, unpolished gems by the sea. It’s a little tucked away near Ngor beach, but once you get there, it’s rustic tables, feet in the sand, waves crashing in the background. Beach tables fill up quickly so arrive early to avoid disappointment.

I had the grilled lobster—fresh and cooked beautifully—but it lacked that garlicky, buttery flavour I was craving. The homemade chips, though, were delicious. Choosing your lobster fresh and seeing it weighed before cooking definitely adds to the experience.

The place is popular with families, especially on weekends. It’s a lively, communal, vibe full of local energy. Expect a few craft sellers walking around offering handmade goods and there’s some wonderful art to look at next door.

Service is friendly and attentive. It’s the spot for a relaxed lunch or sunset moment. Plus, you can catch a boat across to Ngor Island just steps away for 1,000 CFA round trip. The boats leave frequently and the short ride adds to the bliss of the day. Highly recommended

user_reviews.Name: Katy Wheelock
user_reviews.Description: This is a delightful yet expensive cafe in les Almadies. I found everything I ate to be delicious, and the coffees were quite good as well. I had the feeling that I could stay and visit with my friends for a while and no one was rushing me out. The ambiance and atmosphere was very charming. I was surprised to see wine for sale with the Noliane label; the staff told me they import it from Italy. For Senegal, that was a surprise for me!

user_reviews.Name: C Neon
user_reviews.Description: This is a beautiful Italian restaurant in Dakar.  It is inside a nice hotel with a wine bar.   The chef is from Italy and the dishes were very good as he uses a lot of ingredients from Italy.   The staff is well trained and the atmosphere is very contemporary and relaxing.   A good experience.

user_reviews.Name: Yagazie Emezi
user_reviews.Description: Cute cafe. We sat inside, the bar area is pretty. Ordered a salad and pizza. Both delicious. The main star was their special spicy oil, a must try with your pizza! Ended up buying a bottle of it because it was that good and it’s now like liquid gold in my home. Overall, add this to your list of solid breakfast joints to check out while in Dakar. Super fresh orange juice too.

user_reviews.Name: Jean and Martin Choi
user_reviews.Description: This is probably one of the better restaurants in Dakar. The food is absolutely delicious and well flavored. We love their salads and pasta and most definitely their tiramisu. The environment is lovely. There is an English tea setting inside and a nice little outdoor alcove. The price is a bit on the expensive side, but you do receive the quality of food and ingredients.

user_reviews.Name: diallo karim
user_reviews.Description:
Super nice restaurant. The food is delicious and the menu simple.
The staff will great you and serve you well.

user_reviews.Name: Chop Stay Love
user_reviews.Description:
Caffe Noliane serves up the best pizza I’ve tasted so far in Dakar. The base is thin, crispy, cheesy—just how I like it. Full of flavour and super satisfying.

My only complaint? I wish it was bigger!

Great little spot if you’re craving proper pizza done right.

user_reviews.Name: SANTIAGUE DEPREZ
user_reviews.Description: This is one of my favorite spots in Dakar. The seafood pizza is really the best thing ever. The steak is mouth watering and the burgers are juicy and tasty. What more can I say? The vibe is great indoors or outdoors there are beautiful birds all around the courtyard and the staff is great especially the security guards that greet you at the entrance, always a warm smile and ready to accommodate of needed. The drinks are also amazing and strong! I will eat here every chance I get to visit Dakar!

user_reviews.Name: Tifani Dyson
user_reviews.Description: I meant to take a picture before I ate, but it was just too good. Came here twice this week. The first time I was underwhelmed by the burger, but on the second visit the pizza was AHHmazing. I played it safe with margarita pizza, but the seafood one looks good as well. And I can’t forget the spicy oil that they leave for the table. So good, I wish I could buy some.

user_reviews.Name: Marika Antonino
user_reviews.Description:
My fiancé and I visited JetCafe on Tuesday, 18th November. The place was quite empty probably just because it was a Tuesday. Despite that, the food was amazing!! Everything was really fresh and flavorfulespecially the fish, which was excellent.

The only downside was the plantain it wasn’t fresh, was very hard, and it was reheated in the microwave. I really love plantain, so that was a bit disappointing.

The atmosphere was nice, with some music softly playing in the background. The service was a little slow, which was surprising given that it wasn’t busy.

The location is beautiful , you can enjoy a lovely view of the sea while dining. Overall, aside from the plantain and the slow service, everything else was great. I’ll definitely come back

user_reviews.Name: VASUNDHARA GHILDIYAL
user_reviews.Description: The atmosphere with the waves crashing around and the lounge music booming was an excellent experience 👌. The service was fast and the servers were very nice and welcoming. The food quantities and quality was amazing, would recommend 10/10 in every aspect.

user_reviews.Name: Rihab Kh
user_reviews.Description: I had brunch at Jet Cafe and it was delicious, with a great variety of food. The place is very clean, the staff are nice, well dressed, and well mannered. The view was amazing as well. I would definitely recommend it.

user_reviews.Name: Tariro Mlanda
user_reviews.Description: Breathtaking atmosphere in white and fairy lights along the beach. What more can one want. The views are spectacular especially in the evening. Great service.  The food is very tasty and the portions are huge. However if you are not a fan of garlic, you might not enjoy the fish here for garlic is one of the main ingredients of their fish dishes. The atmosphere is still worth the visit though...

user_reviews.Name: Alex Adeiza
user_reviews.Description:
Jet Cafe Beach marked the very first outing of my 2-day stay in Dakar, Senegal. We went as a family and this place was just on point for us to neutralize the cold, eat and either watch the sun kiss the sea, or feets ride the ski.
The food was awesome - let’s keep it at that.
The service is where I had a bit of a problem because of language barrier. I had a bit of French to go by, but no staff could speak as much English as I did French. Well, Google translator helped a bit much.
The atmosphere was good. Light music, beautiful view, great white ambience with a glow of love all around to give that perfect picturesque. Nice nice 😊

user_reviews.Name: Hannah P
user_reviews.Description:
A beautiful restaurant overlooking the Atlantic Ocean! It was breezy, clean, and the staff were very friendly.

The menu is just a bit pricey, but understandable because the location and service were amazing! Would definitely recommend. :)

user_reviews.Name: Adam in Africa
user_reviews.Description: I had a nice dinner here: Fresh fish, with vegetables, rice, and a side salad, and a nice crepe with ice-cream for dessert. The service is great, you are right on the beach, and the restaurant has a nice atmosphere.

user_reviews.Name: Yeesh Rose
user_reviews.Description: Amazing views and great customer service. However food quality could have been better and the food could be hotter in temperature. The plantain was divine and freshly made though, yuummm!!

user_reviews.Name: Jean and Martin Choi
user_reviews.Description: Beautiful outdoor space to enjoy the ocean and delicious food. The drinks and dishes were all well prepared. Though the price is a bit high, the taste was great. Customer service was great. Atmosphere was great. We were also offered handmade chocolate morsels on our way out.

user_reviews.Name: Ranjeeta Sharma
user_reviews.Description: Beautiful ocean facing view. Mesmerizing and enchanting especially if you plan to have an early breakfast or brunch. The staff is well trained and polite. Food was ok we'd brunch. Drinks were mediocre and could improve those for sure. They over charge for a 500 ml water bottle though. Would recommend specially for the great view and vibe.

user_reviews.Name: Capricorn Sundae
user_reviews.Description: This was my first time visiting the country and this was hands down the best restaurant I’ve experienced while touring. The food is absolutely fantastic. The view is phenomenal and our servers were polite and kind. I truly enjoyed myself, 100% recommend!!

user_reviews.Name: Chop Stay Love
user_reviews.Description:
Le Cabanon is hands-down my go-to place in Dakar. I come here 3–4 times a week to watch the waves, the surfers, and the sunset—it’s just a beautiful, comfortable and relaxing spot.

The food is great—especially the pain perdu (French toast), which is an absolute must-try. Everything is served fresh and with care.

The staff are always warm and welcoming, and there’s always someone nearby if you need anything. Compared to other restaurants along the coast, Le Cabanon stands out as the best by far.

I also love the little detail of being offered a chocolate at the till when you leave—it’s a sweet, thoughtful touch that wraps up the experience perfectly and always makes me smile.

If you’re into art, you’ll definitely appreciate the unique decor and creative atmosphere.

Thank you for Le Cabanon!

user_reviews.Name: Aijan K
user_reviews.Description: The view is beautiful, especially if you catch the sunset. Interior is also very nice. We ordered muscles. They were is this tomato sauce, not what I’m used to in US. Drinks can be too sweet, but I’ll go for the view again.

user_reviews.Name: Lucky Abraham
user_reviews.Description:
Had a nice time at Le Cabanon. There is a nice chilled view of the Atlantic with good musical vibes. Recommended for individuals or groups.

The waiters can do better in their service.

user_reviews.Name: Jan
user_reviews.Description:
This restaurant is definitely a place to go if you like to take photos of you and the surrounding and the food.

I went with a party of 5 total for brunch on a Friday morning. It was surprisingly not busy during this hour. We sat out by the ocean and it was great vibes.

What was initially confusing was the way the brunch menu selection worked. The first four of us were given two brunch selection total where we had to fill out for two people on one. This could be done better with an indicator where it’s being selected for 1 or 2 persons.

The food was decently good and decent amount of food as well. That was nice. I ended up being full and enjoyed that I could eat most of what I ordered.

Overall, service was great. I liked that. Bathrooms were clean, I assume this is managed by a non-Senegalese or someone who knows their stuff about running a business catering to tourists and foreigners who look for comfort and luxury while in Senegal.
Just like their ‘In Regards To” statement on their website, “Le Cabanon is an experience where pleasure, sharing and indulgence come together” … they have that down to the tea.

user_reviews.Name: Lulu B
user_reviews.Description:
Really nice location by the sea and the staff were super attentive and friendly!

However, if I lived in Dakar this would turn into the spot I’d visit for a couple of drinks instead because it’s super pricey and I’d struggle to see the value if I visited for food. I was shocked the bill came to the same average price as a high end restaurant in London!!

user_reviews.Name: Neske Beks
user_reviews.Description:
I was having a great ginger tea. My last night in Dakar...
Felt a bit overaged for the spot - i am 53- , but no problem: I do have kids that age.
I paid. Cash asked the very friendly waiter who was a darling. Nothing wrong with him and most of personnel... (4 stars for them)
But what insulted me was some youngster-waiter following me, asking me if I had payed... 😳😳😱🥵
Very unprofessional : he should have checked it with his colleague instead of assuming this about... my looks? (Dreadlocks, Colors, - I'm an artist...???)

I had to leave this feedback cause it spoiled my last evening of a great week in Dakar.
I felt so good and happy among my people. All Black people. And then this....

user_reviews.Name: Nomad USA
user_reviews.Description:
Nice view, great service. I had a cocktail called a Florida; rhum, pineapple, orange, some other ingredients. Sweet and tart.  I’d order it again. I also had the Brazilian steak and the salmon poke bowl. The salmon was ok, I thought it would be fresh raw salmon, but it was smoked. The Brazilian filet with walnuts was tender, and pretty good. But it tasted tenderized, with a hammer or enzyme. And not really a filet, more like rump cut into strips. It was 5000 more than the regular filet or entrecôte. Not sure if id order it again. Probably tastes the same as the others. Unfortunately no where in this country will you find a nice marbled NY strip, sirloin, or real T-bone. The meat in the city  has little fat, generally not aged, and not grain fed. Only a few places cut the steaks properly. The search for a good steak continues. The grilled veggies were good.  No Gazelle. The only local beer is a small flag. Calm location.  Nice spot to watch the waves, take a date, have a sundowner.

Went back again in February 2023
Super chill terrace bar overlooking the Atlantic. A bit on the pricey side, friendly service, good variety of menu items.
The tagliatelle de mer is my favorite. Heavy on the shrimps, clams and squid. Wasn’t happy with the gnocchi. They substituted gnocchi with pasta shells. I asked why, the staff didn’t see the issue, they insisted that it was gnocchi. Also had the tagliatelle with mullet Bottarga and clams. Loved that dish too. There was plenty of Bottarga mixed in. Also had the niçois salad, instead of mozzarella they put in hard boiled eggs. Bit different. Also had the carbonara in tagliatelle. Bit thick but creamy and tasty. And finally the Brazilian Steak. More $ than regular entrecôte, tasty but chewy. Not really sure it was Brazilian. It was super lean, just like the local meat. It wasn’t really cut well, somewhat jagged. All the dishes were well played. I think I’ll stick to the seafood dishes. Good cocktails, great for a sundowner. Will go back again . I wish they had draft or gazelle.

user_reviews.Name: Bart Vander Plaetse
user_reviews.Description: Nice sea view terrace, decent Italian kitchen. Barman with good cocktail skills.

user_reviews.Name: Saskia Holman
user_reviews.Description: The spaghetti pomodoro was easily the best pasta I’ve ever had in Dakar. Service was fast and friendly and beautiful view of the ocean.

user_reviews.Name: chamberlain BABA
user_reviews.Description:
Service is not the best
Food is good
Music is too loud
Expect eating in a club instead of a restaurant
no conversation possible even tho ur sitting next to each other

user_reviews.Name: Seynabou Nd
user_reviews.Description: Good food, nice staff but seating could be more confortable

user_reviews.Name: jatin hans
user_reviews.Description: You can enjoy good food with great view .

user_reviews.Name: Daniel Holt
user_reviews.Description: Great view, great staff, lovely environment, pity it was a less than impressive salmon poke bowl. I suspect they ran out of half the ingredients and tried to make it work. Very disappointed with the food.

user_reviews.Name: runningdogyankee
user_reviews.Description: Food is fine. Service is good. On weekend evenings you might be trapped between loud music coming from other restaurants on both sides of this place.

user_reviews.Name: Mariel Camargo
user_reviews.Description: Really good food! I got the Cassolette de Poulpe Au Piment Et Riz Thai & it was delicious. I also got Boyee juice & it was amazingly delicious. However for the price, I dint think it’s worth it & you can definitely go to a more affordable restaurant with potentially more flavor. Staff was so nice and accommodating though! Views are also stunning.

user_reviews.Name: Laila Khalil
user_reviews.Description: Really amazing view! Also the restaurant is adorable and the staff are super friendly. It’s a nice place to hangout and watch the sunset over the ocean.

user_reviews.Name: HISTRO zhang
user_reviews.Description:
My first meal in Senegal. The environment is good, you are facing the Atlantic Ocean while sitting there.
I ordered a fish, named captain something, and a beer. The fish is cod, fresh, but the cooking is nothing special. But the taste is good because of the sauce. The sauce with fish is with coconut and mango flavor, the source with olives is a bit spicy, both light up the taste.

user_reviews.Name: Alex F
user_reviews.Description:
This restaurant is a beautiful gem located right on the water, with waves crashing just below if you’re lucky enough to get a seat right by the water. If you get here early enough for dinner, wasn’t so difficult to do. It was still busy, seems like a popular spot.

The service is attentive and friendly, and the food was beautifully cooked, chargrilled chicken - a must, I recommend!

The ambience is very chill and on the quiet side, but with the waves and delicious cuisine - it’s fantastic!

user_reviews.Name: Radna
user_reviews.Description: Big disappointment. The view is beautiful and the place is really cosy, but our Sunday lunch was really bad quality. The potatoes, chicken and meat were cooked the day before, super dry and tasting old. The prices are higher than in other restaurants nearby, and definitely it's not worth it.  I won't go back.

user_reviews.Name: Christian Gant
user_reviews.Description: The food here was very delicious and filing. The staff here was very friendly, resourceful and attentive. Our food also came out quickly.

user_reviews.Name: Gino
user_reviews.Description: Very pleasant place with a breathtaking view of the sea to enjoy a cocktail in all simplicity.

user_reviews.Name: Jay Shapiro
user_reviews.Description:
Amazingly fresh seafood meal, literally on the edge of the ocean. Beautiful view.

We had the sea urchins which were incredible and worth trying.

They take Visa.

Walk down the alley towards the water and turn left at the very end. Up a few steps.

user_reviews.Name: Amanda Weilenmann
user_reviews.Description:
This place serves delicious and fresh seafood. We ate a ton of goose barnacles. I tried fresh sea urchin for the first time and they were actually pretty good. We also enjoyed fish and some grilled clams. It was a very fun experience. The place is open and right next to the beach.

We arrived right when they were opening and it was pretty quiet - we were here in December 2023. Our server was kind and attentive and we managed to order everything and ask questions despite us not speaking French of Wolof. It's a very fun place and a definitely a place to visit.

user_reviews.Name: coco thiam
user_reviews.Description:
I am so disappointing.
About this restaurant. One thing I notice is the lady sitting in the desk are so rude. There's a young lady over there there. There's the old lady over there. They all route ready to argue with the customers. They don't know customer service and the guy who saved me. I asked him if you have butter for my lobster. He told me he didn't have it. And when I walked to the frigerator there was a butter right there.  After I'd paid $85 for just lobster.I don't have a good service.The place is dirty.People are rude.I never go back there on my life

user_reviews.Name: Sebastien Perrine
user_reviews.Description: Nice ses food maquis. Never experienced one before. Lot of seafood on the menu of course. Price is way more affordable than fancy restaurant. Recipes are simple and straightforward. If you're a sea shell lover go there. It's just next to the sea , in summer you'll get some nice fresh air. Alcoholic drinks are available. Toilets are available. Not that clean but its up to the task. The employees are respectful and helpful. No payments by card. WiFi is even available. Parking are available around. I don't know how it is during peak periods. Place is secure. Nice place to enjoy a moment with friends in a simplest way.

user_reviews.Name: John Koen
user_reviews.Description: Service was a bit off but I think due to Ramadan (we arrived right at 7pm). Calamari Brochette was excellent, monkfish brochette was good. Local oysters were cheap (2,000 F a dozen), to my taste a bit too much iodine in the flavor, but at that price, I might even order again. The star was the grilled thiof (local white snapper) that had the very interesting sauce with a bit of a tang grilled into the skin. Maybe the second best cooked fish I ever had?

user_reviews.Name: Maam Saay (YOLO)
user_reviews.Description: Seafood was fresh and great! The fresh air from the sea is divine. Nice atmosphere.

user_reviews.Name: Nomad USA
user_reviews.Description: Super chill terrace fish house. Local steamed  oysters, clams, calamari, mussels, urchin, langoustine, gambas,  fish brochettes,  bbq, and beer. Modest prices, great views of crashing waves and sunsets 🌅.

user_reviews.Name: Fadzil Baharudin
user_reviews.Description:
Good seafood with nice view. I did not check the pricing (because someone else paid) but the good thing is this restaurant accepted major credit cards. The environment was clean and as far as I remember, no flies flew around.

For the food, they are serving typical sea species and they are fresh. The waiting period was not too long even though for 20 people of us.

For the view, it was stunning! Nothing else can be said.

user_reviews.Name: Julie Willey
user_reviews.Description: Really pleasant experience. I speak very little french and the staff was helpful and tried to accommodate me. Nice very, nice weather, good music.

user_reviews.Name: ovey yeung 楊傲斐
user_reviews.Description: Loved being able to eat and tan and dip myself in the pool. The bathroom is limited and no change room so it’s best if you change at home and come. There’s a shower outside. One bathroom for ladies and one bathroom for men shared in a common area with no door.

user_reviews.Name: David Walker
user_reviews.Description: This place has always been a really nice little spot on Viviers Beach. They recently renovated and now it is a bit more of a classy spot but it still has a nice relaxed feel. The food is excellent. The service is fairly relaxed but friendly.

user_reviews.Name: Inês João
user_reviews.Description: Nice beach club with good food and great views. There are also chairs by the beach you can lay down and enjoy the view and surfers. Good to spend one full day! Prices are ok, however you can only pay with cash. Waitresses are nice and waiting time is good.  They also feature a small swimmingpool but you have to pay to use. Direct access to a small rocky beach.

user_reviews.Name: Mihanta Rak
user_reviews.Description:
Best place for kids and family time in Almadies.
The pool is little but children can play there alone. A very good lifeguard who keeps eyes on kids.
Staff are very cool and there is a playground too.
Food is good as well. For cocktail lover, mojito is good there 😋
We recommend of course 👌

user_reviews.Name: sam kaasjong
user_reviews.Description: The food was good taste but when you go to your hotel you wil Find out something wasn’t right….

user_reviews.Name: Kharmencita Bridges
user_reviews.Description: Nice place to experience the sunset view and where the young surfers enjoying there water activities and of course excellent foods too😍.

user_reviews.Name: Ernesto A
user_reviews.Description: Food was great. Service was decent. The views spectacular. Nice place to visit.

user_reviews.Name: Nacer Eddine Mahfoudh
user_reviews.Description:
recently visited Sharky’s in Dakar, and it was a great experience. We ordered a pizza along with the mixed seafood platter, and both dishes were delicious.
The pizza was well-cooked with a flavorful crust and fresh toppings, while the seafood platter was generous and full of tasty, well-seasoned seafood.

The atmosphere was friendly and relaxed, and the staff were welcoming and attentive. Overall, Sharky’s is a great spot to enjoy good food, especially if you love seafood or want a nice place to eat with friends.

I highly recommend it!

user_reviews.Name: Leslie Santaella
user_reviews.Description: The food was very good and I enjoyed their shrimp tempura soup. I originally ordered Thiof fish as my main dish, but it had an off taste, but they were gracious enough to change it to the shrimp platter.  The portions were all  very generous  and fulfilling. The environment was relaxing and a perfect place to watch surfers chase the big waves!

user_reviews.Name: Stan Levenger
user_reviews.Description: Great place for sushi or pub food on the beach. Sushi menu is extensive with many mainstay and more local options. Very large selection of liquors and mixed drinks but the beer selection is somewhat limited. Atmosphere is very nice with the proximity to the water. Recommend for a very casual and relaxing experience with a nice food selection at a reasonable price.

user_reviews.Name: Ousman Touray
user_reviews.Description: Amongst so many hidden gems on the coastline of Almadies. Sharky's is a calm Cool place with super friendly staff and a beautiful view of the Atlantic Ocean. Check it out if you're in the area.

user_reviews.Name: destination wa
user_reviews.Description: Wonderful atmosphere,  quirky menu with the normal offerings then the sushi. However, the gyoza has some odd wrapping around it, not at all normal!  A great place to chill out although pricey

user_reviews.Name: Amadou Karim Kane
user_reviews.Description: Awesome place! The ocean view is remarkable!!! The food selection is okay and reasonably priced for the area, and the staff is always friendly. I will recommend it, especially during the day to enjoy the view 👌🏾

user_reviews.Name: Esayas Girmay
user_reviews.Description: A cool place by the beach at Almadies Dakar. Food was ok but service not very much so, location is superb with a view to the Atlantic ocean looking at surfers enjoying their experience. The restaurant can do a lot better with their majestic location though.

user_reviews.Name: Se Ku
user_reviews.Description: Enjoyed a nice burger with a mango dakiri here. It's a very nice place to enjoy the sun and wind down.  The fries, especially that come with the burger, were really good.

user_reviews.Name: HISTRO zhang
user_reviews.Description:
We ordered sandwich, spring roll and noodle.
The noodle is totally NOT recommended, since it taste like something from other planet, nothing in common with my experience. But in other hand, the spring roll is quite well, also the sandwich(chicken).
Considering the rare Vietnam food choice in Dakar, it worth for a try, but again, not the noodle!

user_reviews.Name: Worldwide Reviewer
user_reviews.Description: A hidden gem. Perfectly cooked, flavourful dishes, served with care. Premises are not impressive but the food is well worth it. There was an issue with the card machine, therefore have some cash for such situations.

user_reviews.Name: Maria Hy
user_reviews.Description: Came with my family because I was missing Asian food. I was pleasantly surprised. The food was fresh and well made. The portions were generous. There were vegetarian options.  I especially enjoyed the papaya salad and bo bun.  The kids liked the nem and gyozas. The decor inside was clean and comfortable.  Good for small groups.  Their delivery seems popular too. I will definitely come back!

user_reviews.Name: Sabrina West
user_reviews.Description:
Best Asian take away in town!
Always fresh, delivered fast, nicely boxed and still hot!!! Very tasty
I definitely recommend

user_reviews.Name: Eyad K
user_reviews.Description: Momo is very good

user_reviews.Name: Elodie Michel
user_reviews.Description: Amazing food, delicious, very tasty. Worth the price!!

user_reviews.Name: Seydina Nouha Coly
user_reviews.Description: Communication digitale

user_reviews.Name: FALL .Bodiel
user_reviews.Description: Ce n’est pas la première fois que l’on mange chez Bamboo et nous ne sommes jamais déçus! Le gérant est très accueillant et vous guide pour les plats. La cuisine est savoureuse et a le goût de l’authentique et du fait maison. Mention spéciale au Pho au bœuf et au Pad thaï qui étaient délicieux. Je recommande à 100% !

user_reviews.Name: Worldwide Reviewer
user_reviews.Description:
Nestled along the stunning coastline of Dakar, Exotic Beach offers a delightful escape with its serene atmosphere and attentive service. From the moment you arrive, the staff makes you feel welcome, striking a perfect balance between professionalism and warmth.

I ordered the fish of the day, which took about 40 minutes to arrive. While the fish didn’t quite meet expectations—it seemed more frozen than fresh compared to other local spots—the overall dining experience was elevated by thoughtful touches. Complimentary nuts served as a starter and a refreshing mint tea to close the meal added a layer of charm that’s hard to overlook.
Whether you're there to soak in the ocean breeze or enjoy a laid-back meal with friends, Exotic Beach delivers a memorable experience that goes beyond the plate. With just a bit more attention to the freshness of the seafood, this place could easily become a top-tier favorite.

user_reviews.Name: Fadima
user_reviews.Description: Lovely restaurant in Dakar. Great staff who come to check on you regularly and will do everything to make you feel at ease. Wide range of food made authentically well. We had a great time!

user_reviews.Name: Briana H.
user_reviews.Description:
I went in the midday so the sun was beaming. Just be careful because although some seats are close to the coast and there may be a breeze you want to make sure there is an umbrella to cover you.

I had a fruit salad and it was better than I expected. The waiter didn't speak English but he tried his best by using the Google translate app which I appreciated.

There is no alcohol.

I would definitely go back again during an evening.

Great view of the surfers catching waves.

user_reviews.Name: HISTRO zhang
user_reviews.Description: I came for burgers but there is Brunch menu only in weekend. As the picture it is quite abundant. But, beside the pancakes which came later is a bit “fresh”, all others are “well prepared” with quite a bit of time, since the bread are all cold. And the environment is really not that fancy, there are at least 5 flies keep circling and it is really annoying.

user_reviews.Name: Sokhna Mbacke
user_reviews.Description: The restaurant offers good food, but the customer service was poor. Respect should be standard, not something customers have to insist on. Staff training is clearly needed.

user_reviews.Name: Tariro Mlanda
user_reviews.Description: Had a horrible experience here. Granted we visited during Ramadan hence they were serving the Ramadan menu till about 8 or 9pm then other menus after this. The service was soo slow and unresponsive we left without having even a drink. They do however have a great view of the sea.

user_reviews.Name: Elage N.
user_reviews.Description: Decent food great service with a nice scenic location. Our waiter, Papi, gave us exceptional service.

user_reviews.Name: Yh
user_reviews.Description: Vous méritez meme 10 étoiles. The food was so delicious and well served. Thank you

title: COPACABANA SURF VILLAGE
address: QG33+QGF COPACABANA SURF VILLAGE, Dakar, Senegal

user_reviews.Name: dian _fatima
user_reviews.Description: I stumbled upon this gem in Dakar, Senegal, initially just for food, but ended up discovering a whole surf village! I took surfing lessons here for the first time, and it was an incredible experience. The service is outstanding, the staff is super friendly, and the surf instructors are passionate and talented. Whether you're a seasoned surfer or a beginner like me, this place should definitely be on your itinerary when visiting Senegal. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Sara Y
user_reviews.Description: Good service, nice place,  good spot.. I didn't try the food there so I can't advice on that.. but the sunset from there is what got me 😊

user_reviews.Name: Taeyoung Kim
user_reviews.Description: Very cozy and yet lively place. Just be careful when you sit outside, merchants will endlessly come and try to sell their stuff but it was quite manageable though I think. Good starting point to surf and many people enjoyed playing football, kites and badminton like sports.

user_reviews.Name: Arabang Dingalo
user_reviews.Description: Copacabana is THE spot in Dakar! Relax, read a book or meet a friend, watch the surfers and the waves (or take a surf class!), Copa is so relaxing and refreshing. The poulet was so delicious and the service was wonderful. It’s definitely going to be my staple every time I’m in Dakar. They also have blankets when it gets a little chilly at sunset.

user_reviews.Name: Omomone Iris lesly
user_reviews.Description: The place is nice and the prices are quiet affordable for a dinner , the view on the beach is just amazing, would recommend this place for people who want to spend some family’s time

user_reviews.Name: Leon Hady
user_reviews.Description:
Yeah, this has a lithe but if beach in front of it which seemed excellent for surf. Reasonably priced burgers for catching late lunch and hawkers seem to have caught surfer vibes and we’re too laid back to really hassle.

Real range of people, older surfers, backpapers, a few locals and service and food were good.

user_reviews.Name: Janette Nimmo
user_reviews.Description: Great place to watch the surfers. The food is great but the toilets aren't very good. Don't always flush or have seats but the food & view is amazing & very cheap priced.

user_reviews.Name: Saskia Holman
user_reviews.Description: Super cute spot to sit and have brunch on a Saturday. Lots of family and kids all around. Food was super tasty.

user_reviews.Name: diallo karim
user_reviews.Description: Lovely restaurant! The decor is pretty and brings you to japan in an instant. The staff is really kind and helpful. lastly but not least, the food was delicious specially the sashimi combo and the sushi. The fish was extremely fresh!. We had a amazing time there thanks to the staff.

user_reviews.Name: Sk Ste
user_reviews.Description: One of the best restaurant in my whole experience. Yes. The food is absolutely great, tasty, healthy. Excellent service. Nice atmosphere. I honestly feel lucky having the chance to eat there now, I guess that when it will be better known -as it should be - there may be less availability, higher prices, or difficult to sustain the same quality level, but the passion of the owners will still make the difference, I’m sure of it.

user_reviews.Name: Hilde Jakobsen
user_reviews.Description: Lovely gentle service: kind, attentive, patient. The menu is short but well thought out. Every single thing we ordered was delicious.

user_reviews.Name: Minoukis Places
user_reviews.Description:
Really excellent food, service and atmosphere! Newly opened by Japanese family. The quality of the food and sushi especially was outstanding, we’ve been to quite a few sushi places and this is one of the best!

The entrance is hidden in a back alley and access with a car can be challenging, but there should be space for 1-3 cars…

user_reviews.Name: Stéphanie L
user_reviews.Description: The best Japanese restaurant in Dakar. Nice and attentive staffs, very fresh and tasty food, fast service. Highly recommended we will comeback soon.

user_reviews.Name: Epsod
user_reviews.Description: The best japanese experience I had in my whole life ! I ordered a traditional ramen and was blown away by the quality of the ingredients and by the amazing taste that it has. The room is very well designed and decorated. The waiters are very polite and joyful. Being a japan lover myself, this felt like a litteral journey through this amazing culture ! Congratulations to all the staff !!!! This was a wondeful experience !!

user_reviews.Name: Bart Vander Plaetse
user_reviews.Description: Excellent Japanese haute cuisine, charming owners and staff, authentic interior. I especially loved the entré of algae, but all food was super tasty and beautifully presented. Not to be missed!!!! And we will be back soon. Congratulations to owners and staff!

user_reviews.Name: Y. S.M.
user_reviews.Description: Beautiful space covered in raw woods, amazing flatware and glasses paired with delicious food. New Japanese restaurant serving the Yoff / Virage area in a quiet residential area. They also have a nice outdoor area. Much success!

user_reviews.Name: Capricorn Sundae
user_reviews.Description: Food was delicious and fresh. We ordered the wings as an appetizer (great choice). For the entree, I ordered the club sandwich. It was very tasty, made with fresh ingredients. Honestly everything was really good, I would visit again if i didn’t live in another country.

user_reviews.Name: Francine Nkongo
user_reviews.Description:
Very tasty food! I am not a fan of fish however this meal was very tasty. I would recommend. We went during the day and had a great choice of seating.

The restaurant is tucked away next to Jungle and the paddle/tennis courts.

user_reviews.Name: Ro Law
user_reviews.Description: Hotel staff recommended this spot. I didn't realize it was right on the water but I loved it. The waitress was super kind and patient as I don't speak French. The grilled shrimp was delicious and the dj's music made it a vibe! 💃🏾

user_reviews.Name: Chop Stay Love
user_reviews.Description:
Le Carré is a bit tricky to find—you’ll need to head toward Rocca Marina and go behind the football pitches to get there. Once inside, the setting is beautiful: comfy sofas, a sea view, and a perfect spot to watch the surfers off to the left. The hostesses were welcoming, and the space itself is nicely designed.

That said, the music was louder than I’d like and didn’t quite match the relaxing coastal vibe—it felt more like a lounge trying to push a shisha bar atmosphere, which clashed with the setting for me.

The menu was a bit limited during my visit. I came in hoping for fresh fish, especially being right by the sea, but they didn’t have what I wanted available and suggested meat instead, which wasn’t quite what I was after.

Nice spot to chill and have drinks.

user_reviews.Name: Fab E
user_reviews.Description: Was a bit tricky to find but nice location in general. We were seated directly and didn't wait. That was for the positive side. The music was loud, while ordering our food, the waitress told us that the fish was fresh and it was written grilled on the menu, but once the food arrived we were disappointed. The food was cold, the fish wasn't fresh and the chicken dry. The only good point was the ginger juice. We do not recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Alex F
user_reviews.Description:
I really enjoyed the evening at Le Carré Dakar, I came here for dinner alone. From the beginning the staff were welcoming and very friendly.

The interior is semi-outside, and if you can get the seats by the water it’s amazing, the waves just beneath - there are also lounges right above the waves if you wish.

I heard the cocktails are great here, so I tried a few flavored mojitos and they did not disappoint - watch out they are quite strong.

I had Dorade Braisée and that was probably the best fish dish I have ever had! The flavours were incredible, it was cooked to perfection and Aloco as a side just made it all come together. It’s a must try!

Restaurant has a nice vibe, there’s music so it’s a bit of a restaurant lounge place, imagine it gets a bit wilder later in the night. It was busy with locals and tourists - don’t miss it if you’re in Dakar.

user_reviews.Name: Khady Graydon
user_reviews.Description: There was construction happening - very loud and upsetting me and my guests. I couldn’t even speak when someone was right next to me. I’m not sure why they wanted to fix whatever they were doing while the guest were here but it was way too loud and not relaxing at all. We were with kids and they started to cry from how loud the noise was.

user_reviews.Name: Se Ku
user_reviews.Description: A little on the pricier end, but it's a nice little place with good music if you are looking to wind with a nice view. The food is also quite good. I had the pepper steak, it was tender and cooked perfectly. As for the cocktails, you can ask for the mango passion fruit (it's not on the menu), but compliments to the bartender and waitress for suggesting it.

user_reviews.Name: Samuel Thorpe
user_reviews.Description: Server Diarra and Manager Massood at Seven Seven Restaurant in Dakar Senegal, this people are doing a fantastic job. The foods are very delicious and the service is top notch the restaurant is very clean especially the toilet everything is in good condition. My wife and I enjoyed our time there everything is 100% my wife and I will be coming back on the 14th February 2026 for there Valentines special. Thank you so much Manager Massood and Server Diarra for your warm hospitality keep up the good work 🫡.

user_reviews.Name: Alassane Chérif
user_reviews.Description: Our waitress, Elisabeth, was absolutely amazing. She had such a positive attitude and was attentive to all of our needs throughout the entire experience. I will definitely recommend her to anyone who comes here. In addition, the manager, Massoud, was extremely attentive and very friendly, which made our visit even more enjoyable.

user_reviews.Name: Aboudi Ghazal
user_reviews.Description:
Absolutely amazing experience at this steakhouse! 🥩The quality of the meat was exceptional, cooked to perfection and bursting with flavor. The ambiance is sophisticated yet cozy, making it perfect for any occasion. The staff was knowledgeable and attentive, enhancing our dining experience. Highly recommend for steak lovers—5 stars all the way!
Also the Saumon Crispy & Gambas (In the Entrees Section )
Will Visit again soon 👍🏻

user_reviews.Name: ADA SHYNE
user_reviews.Description: Amazing service, very tasty food, overall stellar experience 🤍 All smiles here.

user_reviews.Name: Madina Seydi
user_reviews.Description:
You can tell that the staff is well traines in this restaurant. with Massod au petit soin and paying attention to details.
Vraiment top quoi. Bravo

user_reviews.Name: Tifani Dyson
user_reviews.Description: *Late Post* - Went to SevenSeven for Valentine's Day, and was happy to find that they did not have a set menu like other places in Dakar. The restaurant was nicely decorated for the valentine's day theme and they even gave roses and a gift box to those dining in. The service was top tier, which was a pleasant surprise. The good: The calamari appetizer was freaking delicious, the steak was amazing and the mini show that went along with it was fun. The drinks/cocktails were also very well done. The not so good: The side dishes were a bit bland and I would avoid the cream spinach, also be prepared for a large price tag. I would definitely come again - but only for special occasions.

user_reviews.Name: Diahara Tarha
user_reviews.Description: Massood and Dounia took great care of us. The service and the food was excellent!

user_reviews.Name: Marieme Sow
user_reviews.Description: Very disappointing place, we waited an hour for our food, the server told us they burnt the dinner and we had to order again. I would not recommend this place

user_reviews.Name: Awa Ndiaye
user_reviews.Description: Love it.. the service is a little slow.. but the food is delicious.. will definitely recommend. Which they could be faster in the taking orders and keep up with customer to make sure they dont need anything

user_reviews.Name: chuka Gold
user_reviews.Description: Great place for a weekend starter before you head out into the night for an all nighter. About the food well I didn't really enjoy it but in all I recommend for any visiting tourists around the area.

title: L'Adresse Dakar
description: Colourful rooms & suites in a chic hotel with an outdoor pool, a rooftop bar & a stylish restaurant.

user_reviews.Name: Brian Johnson
user_reviews.Description:
Absolutely loved this hotel. The location in Almadies is perfect, and the building itself is beautiful — high ceilings, airy spaces, and a relaxed coastal feel.

The staff are exceptional, especially Anissa, who truly went above and beyond to help me arrange a driver to St. Louis and onward to The Gambia. That kind of personal care makes all the difference.

There’s a great rooftop bar, balconies in the rooms, and at night you can hear the ocean — which is pretty magical.

They even have a cat named Croissant, who I want to take with me. If you’re concerned about allergies, don’t be — the space is large and well-ventilated, so it’s not an issue.

Hard to ask for more from a hotel. I’d absolutely stay here again.

user_reviews.Name: timtraveler14
user_reviews.Description: I really loved my stay at L’Adresse.  The entire staff was so friendly.  Especially Thierry, the excellent server at the rooftop restaurant.  That restaurant was so nice, you can sit in the sun and look out over the ocean.  The airport shuttle was very nice.  And the hotel is close to a mosque and the Embassy of Guinea for onward travel.  The hotel is great!

user_reviews.Name: Matias Almang
user_reviews.Description:
I loved my stay at L’Adresse. The staff are very friendly and accommodating. They really make a great effort for your stay to be pleasant.

Even with my basic French, they were very patient and understanding. And they also spoke English.

The hotel has a nice rooftop bar, beautiful to enjoy the sunsets. The downstairs bar also offers nice drinks. The food is delicious!

The location is good, close to nice restaurants.

Thanks very much!

user_reviews.Name: lucifer796
user_reviews.Description: I want to say special thanks to Anissa J.M Seck who works reception. She is super professional, friendly, kind and understanding. She deserves a raise in salary. Other than that, personnel is friendly and professional. Why i can’t give the 5 stars is because personnel working the restaurant is completely clueless what infredients are in the food, which can cause fatal accidents if person is allergic to seafood etc. Because we had an instance where my companion ordered vegetarian food yet they brought seafood option and waiter argued that it’s vegetables and went twice to the kitchen to ask the chef where chef just confirmed its vegetarian option. After some arguing, the waiter agreed to take the food to the kitchen and informed that the correct order is coming (not admitting the mistake). Next time it happend on next day during breakfast when me companion asked if spring rolls contain meat to which waiter said no, that its vegetarian, which was also completely false. So get that together please. Rooms are spacious and clean. Cleaning staff do the great job upkeep the place in cleanliness. There is parking outside the hotel with 24/7 security. Overall great place, but just educate staff and kitchen to take orders and allergens seriously.

user_reviews.Name: Vanessa Cheris
user_reviews.Description:
THE GOOD
Room was spacious. It’s a newly built hotel so everything is clean and relatively modern, albeit simple

The Senegalese food at the rooftop bar was fantastic. The tieb rice was on point and fish, wonderful. We also had the beef skewers and plantains but get the traditional meals. The waiter didn’t understand our order and gave us double the amount of meals we asked for instead of a side, so they over-charged but it tasted great, and it was nice ambiance up there.

THE BAD
The room is missing basic amenities - towels! We had 2 ppl in the room and they refused to bring us enough towels. I called  and went down to reception twice and they still did nothing. No wash cloths, No lotion. They charge close to Pullman prices, but have significantly less amenities

Hotel is solid but should cost closer to 150 USD for what you get, not over 200 USD

user_reviews.Name: Worldwide Reviewer
user_reviews.Description:
I rarely write negative reviews, but my experience at L’dresse Hotel was frustrating enough to warrant one.

Unhelpful staff: The reception staff showed little interest in improving our stay. For two days we were promised that our room change would happen “tomorrow,” yet nothing was done until we insisted repeatedly.

Basic amenities neglected: We had to ask daily for toilet paper and water bottles because room service failed to provide them. For half of our 8‑night stay, we lived with only one towel set, and our requests for additional towels were ignored.

Cockroach problem: Our first room (404) had six cockroaches the moment we opened the door. After moving to room 210, we still encountered three more over the next six days.

Poor room conditions: Rooms smelled of mold and moisture, showers were rusty, and noise isolation was terrible.

Breakfast disappointment: The food selection was minimal and of low quality, far below expectations for a hotel stay.

Confusing hotel name: Even getting to the hotel was a struggle. The name “L’dresse” confused many French‑speaking taxi drivers, and we had to explain the address multiple times before being understood.

Individually, these issues might be tolerable, but combined they created an environment that was uncomfortable and unsuitable for a business trip—especially a longer one. L’dresse Hotel failed to provide even the basics of hospitality, and I cannot recommend it.

user_reviews.Name: Иван Ильин
user_reviews.Description: I had a good stay — the staff were very friendly and helpful, the food was great, and the atmosphere was pleasant. The room was okay, comfortable but could use a bit of improvement. Overall, a nice place to stay in

user_reviews.Name: Lana amir
user_reviews.Description:
I stayed for a week and enjoyed my time there. The staff is really friendly and helpful. The cleaning service is good. The food in the restaurant is also good.

I recommend the administration to provide slippers and 2 water bottles per day :)

user_reviews.Name: Blue Hanley
user_reviews.Description: What can I saw other than really good crêpe! Service was good, it was pretty quiet and they didn't mind us sitting a while after our food. The latté was also good. I'll be back before leaving Dakar for sure to try the sweet crêpes.

user_reviews.Name: Kubera Guide
user_reviews.Description: Elegant and stylish without being pretentious. The view of the ocean, the soft jazz in the background, and the scent of grilled fish — pure magic. The menu mixes French technique with Senegalese soul. My grilled dorado was fresh and tender, served with mango chutney and spicy sauce. The staff spoke French and English, very polite and attentive. I also loved their dessert — coconut mousse with passionfruit. This is where Europe meets Africa in perfect balance. Sophisticated yet full of warmth. Definitely a must-visit when in Dakar!

user_reviews.Description: We stayed in Dakar for one week and discovered la maison de la crêpe on a walk to the hotel.  Excellent in all ways : service, atmosphere, pancakes itself, capucinno was also top. No remarks no suggestions . Five star ! Next time in Dakar I will come back!

Haven't been doing reviews since I have been here but knowing it was an amazing dessert place and Senegalese owned I was genuinely excited to leave a review. TRY The waffles!!!!

title: The Lounge Dakar

user_reviews.Name: Ousman Touray
user_reviews.Description:
The Lounge Dakar is truly a hidden gem. The moment you step inside, it feels like you’ve been transported to a tropical island lush vibes, relaxed atmosphere, and a beautiful setting that immediately puts you at ease. The food is really good and the overall energy of the place is exactly what you want when you’re looking to unwind, enjoy good company, or just escape the busyness of the city for a while.

It’s one of those spots you discover once and already know you’ll be returning. I’ll definitely be back.

user_reviews.Name: Mariel Camargo
user_reviews.Description: Cute restaurant/ bar. Definitely more on the chill vibe- the DJ was doing their thing! He brought the vibes in & the music range was really versatile! Well curated interior & beautiful art :) Service was also very attentive and friendly. Do be warned that this establishment runs on the pricier side. I got the cheapest meal, which was chicken Alfredo penne & it was okay at most- definitely not worth it’s price. They also did not have that many offerings. If I were to come here I would just come here for drinks and get dinner beforehand somewhere else.

user_reviews.Name: Patience
user_reviews.Description: The food was terrible. It had a fake, previously frozen taste, and the ingredients were subpar. The shrimp, unlike the photograph, was disappointing, and the fish was excessively tough. The high price was completely disproportionate to the poor quality. My only highlight was watching folks dancing salsa and kizomba.

user_reviews.Name: Brian Gaines
user_reviews.Description: This is by far the best resturant I went to while in Senegal. During my stay I went to at lest 15 restaurants in different parts of the country including restaurants with beautiful ocean views, but nothing beat this atmosphere. It has an amazing chill and elegant vibe with great food that is very reasonably priced, and friendly staff. It was so good I went there twice and would go again if I was here longer. The place is brand new and everything is in perfect condition. I highly recommend it to anyone visiting or living in Dakar!

user_reviews.Name: Jacpot G-W
user_reviews.Description: I Love this Lounge it is Very classy & clean. Food & drinks are Great. It’s a Vibe. Jasmine is a Very Nice Hostess., the staff is very warm & inviting. They also have Hookah.  No  flies.

user_reviews.Name: Yassine Hoummani
user_reviews.Description: Very delicious food and professional staff

user_reviews.Name: Samuelsecu1 Gaut
user_reviews.Description:
Première visite récemment au The Lounge Dakar, et l’expérience mérite clairement d’être partagée.
Dès l’arrivée, l’accueil est soigné : un agent de sécurité poli, bien présenté, et une entrée avec un accueil personnalisé qui met tout de suite dans l’ambiance. On sent que l’établissement accorde de l’importance aux détails.
Le lieu est très agréable : une belle décoration, des tables installées autour d’une piscine et une ambiance musicale qui crée un cadre détendu mais élégant. L’accueil du personnel est amical et le service est à la hauteur du standing du lieu.
Le menu n’est pas trop chargé, ce qui est souvent bon signe, mais il y a suffisamment de choix pour satisfaire tout le monde. Les plats sont très bons. Les prix sont un peu élevés, mais cohérents avec le cadre et l’expérience proposée.
Un endroit idéal pour un dîner, un rendez-vous ou simplement passer un bon moment dans une belle ambiance à Dakar.
Je recommande cet endroit.

user_reviews.Name: Galinus
user_reviews.Description:
Nous y sommes allés le 1er jour de notre arrivée à Dakar.
Le resto est bien agencé et très beau à l'intérieur. Un gros contraste avec la rue😅
Lieu top, bien accueilli, serveur au petit soin.

user_reviews.Description: The best middle eastern food we’ve ever had! We’ve traveled in the Middle East quite a bit & still this blew us away. The kebabs are delicious and the hummus is amazing. We accidentally ordered a large hummus not realizing it would be a serving bowl size & yet still proceeded to eat all of it because it’s that good! According to my husband this might be his #1 meal of all time (which means something bc we’ve traveled to 100 countries) & had some absolutely incredible meals.
