user_reviews.Description: Incredible food. We loved the hummus. The consistency was incredible. The staff were so friendly - we even got some complimentary baclava! Delicious falafel. Great experience overall.

user_reviews.Name: Mike and Valerie Stephens
user_reviews.Description: This is absolutely the best chicken i have ever eaten anywhere. Amazingly tender and moist. I had no idea a chicken could be this big. Underneath that huge bird are seasoned potatoes and that is garlic sauce not mayonnaise on the side. The owner is very kind and welcoming to families.

user_reviews.Name: Gus Welter
user_reviews.Description: I don’t have the words to describe how good their food is. Exquisite hummus. Grilled chicken so good that I almost shed a tear (I got the Chich Tawouk wrap). Excellent mint lemonade slushy. Go treat yourself!

user_reviews.Description: good food. good drinks. cash only. went around 9pm on a sunday and was completely empty.

user_reviews.Name: Keith Scott
user_reviews.Description: Recently opened in this location serving delicious Lebanese food. The hummus and Kibbeh were fantastic. My partner and I shall definitely be back.

user_reviews.Name: Sean Miller
user_reviews.Description: Truly a hidden gem - it's like a little piece of Italy hidden away in Dakar. World-class Italian cuisine, so good that I came back twice. The seafood pasta in particular is probably better than any I've had anywhere in the world, including Italy! The pizza is also very good. You won't find a better selection of wine anywhere in Dakar - the wine served by the glass was excellent. Service is great and food was always ready quickly.

user_reviews.Name: Tifani Dyson
user_reviews.Description: Haven’t had the chance to dine in yet, but I do plan to return. The pasta looks amazing. I got a pepperoni pizza to go and it was just how I wanted it. One of the best pizzas I’ve had in Dakar this far. I’ll update after my second visit.

user_reviews.Name: Jon Thorstensen
user_reviews.Description: Well... I was a bit slow to find Reine Margherita. It's been there a couple of years. But, better late, than never. And now I am one of the regulars, an ultra you can say. The place is plain and simple, no pretentious glam there. Food: So good. Best pizzas in this town, basta. The pastas also, really made as if you were in some regions of Italy. The ambience is free and loose, the many local Italians always dropping in to this small food station increase this feeling. There are many good reasons why this place is usually packed, sometimes you have to wait or do a takeaway. And those waitresses even adds to the total, which is just incredible. My place, so often.

user_reviews.Name: Danny Melo
user_reviews.Description: Great experience at Reina Margarita! Went there for some pizzas and watching soccer. Pizzas were tasty with fresh ingredients. The service is efficient and the owner very friendly. Price slightly high for beverages though (beers) . Highly recommended !

user_reviews.Name: Bertrand Martin
user_reviews.Description: My "parcours" to find the best pizzas and Italian restaurant in Dakar ended up here. I really like the pizzas and their price is affordable ( you can have medium or large ). The staff when I ate there was always enthusiastic, attentive and nice. I often order for delivery and it is always a pleasure as well.

user_reviews.Name: Alain Lehmann
user_reviews.Description: the place to go in Dakar when you feel like Italian food! great food and friendly staff! the only con is that the space for outside tables is very limited and it's next to a quiet busy street.

user_reviews.Name: Hrvoje Jelinic
user_reviews.Description:
I recently visited this restaurant and was truly impressed, especially by the spaghetti carbonara—it was honestly one of the best I’ve ever had.

The prices are reasonable, and the staff is polite and courteous. However, I did notice that the staff could check on guests a bit more often to see if anyone needs anything.

The terrace is a nice option, but it can get quite noisy and smoky due to the traffic on the busy street outside. On the other hand, the indoor seating is air-conditioned and very comfortable, making it a pleasant place to enjoy your meal.

Overall, I highly recommend this place for its delicious food, fair prices, and friendly atmosphere. Just be aware of the terrace conditions if you prefer to dine outside.

user_reviews.Name: Eduardo Arroyo
user_reviews.Description: This is an small, simple restaurant with great food. Maybe the best pizza in the area or Dakar.

user_reviews.Name: Marika Antonino
user_reviews.Description:
We visited Jungle Dakar last night. When we called the day before, they said no reservation was needed so we could just walk in and request a table!
When we arrived, we asked for a nice table, and the hostess rudely said it was reserved. Instead, she seated us at a small, uncomfortable table with tiny chairs. We asked for another table, but she insisted it wasn’t possible because all were reserved.

We then asked two more waiters/waitresses, and the last one was much nicer. She spoke with the manager, who helped move us to a better table.

Unfortunately, the overall service was very poor. The staff seemed disinterested and unfriendly, the table was not properly cleaned, and there was a noticeable lack of professionalism. The only staff member who was more helpful was the manager, and the last waitress who helped us move tables at least she made an effort to assist!

Regarding the show, when we called, they said there was a DJ and dancers on Saturday and Sunday, but they did not specify the time. We arrived around 22:00 PM, expecting to see the performance, but it was actually scheduled for 1 AM. Since we couldn’t stay that late, we didn’t see the performance. Additionally, the staff working there seemed disinterested and lacked energy, which affected the overall experience! Honestly, the atmosphere and service did not match what you might expect from the videos on TikTok.

On the positive side, the drinks and shisha were okay , and the manager was helpful .

Overall, the service and atmosphere do not meet expectations for the price, and I would not recommend Jungle Dakar unless improvements are made in hospitality, customer care, and communication

user_reviews.Name: Neske Beks
user_reviews.Description:
I was there and felt offended when a young waiter asked me (52yr old woman with rastas) asked me on my way out if I had paid my bill...😳
He should have asked his colleague. Not me.
Such an insult. 😶
And this after paying 4000cfa for ginger tea? 🤔
(Tea gorgeous by the way) the waiter that served me great guy too.

user_reviews.Name: Pape Ndao
user_reviews.Description: This place is awesome! Seriously, if you want a good time, you gotta check it out; the food, service, and music were all spot on. I loved it so much I went back the next day, lol. It's one of my favorite spots in Dakar. Can't wait to go back!

user_reviews.Name: Glo Drums
user_reviews.Description: We called to do a reservation which was aknowledged. We recognize we were late (about 20 minutes)  but no one explained to us that we can pay to keep our table. We arrived and the security guy told us we can't enter because the reservations are put down. But in front of us, he was letting other people enter just after a yes for the question "did you do reservation?". When my brother asked for explanation, he said "we know our clients". Very rude and impolite for someone I can feed every single month without an impact on my finances. On top? Telling us to "get lost". Unfortunately, I'm not sure you (that particular guy) are able to understand english to read this. But if you know your clients just make it a close house for just them. It's not my first or second time going there so I didn't get the point of that nonsense behavior. If it's good, we'll say it. If it's bad, we'll say it because at the end of the day, we are the clients paying with our hard money. You're offering a service and we're paying for it. People don't come there to beg. So try to "educate" your workers.

user_reviews.Name: Aisha Tounkara
user_reviews.Description: Abdellah (the man standing at the entry checking VIP on 30 Decembre) was incredibly rude. We paid 20,000 to come in to watch the Benin Senegal match. When we arrived there were no chairs left, but the waiters were bringing additional chairs. I asked if we could have two chairs and he brought me one. I then asked again for the other chair and he said there were no more, so I went OUTSIDE where they were taking the chairs from and got one myself. Then when I brought it back he came again. I asked him “what is it?” And he’s telling me to calm down. Instead of apologizing for not having chairs. Then he left without even saying what the issue was. Absolutely unprofessional and beyond rude.

user_reviews.Name: Mamadou Diallo
user_reviews.Description: Only thing nice was the atmosphere. Except for the crazy loud music. Food looks pretty, but tastes 2/5 tasting. Don’t order the beef brochette nor the roasted chicken or the plantains. Especially given the price. Please improve.

user_reviews.Name: Alice O'Dwyer
user_reviews.Description:
Incredible views, beautiful spot, super friendly and accommodating staff and most importantly, Senegalese owned!

They have vegan options on request and were so accommodating to dietary requirements when informed.

We will definitely be back upon our next trip back to Dakar. Highly, highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Amie Dibba
user_reviews.Description: Super chill spot during the day. The shrimp pasta is really nice.

user_reviews.Name: Heather Markel - Travel Lifestyle Coach
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely fabulous meal ! This was their first night in their new location. Such a chill area. Beautiful view. The owners are lovely. The food is even better. I felt like I was eating at a friend’s house and the food perfectly hit the spot. I highly recommend it ! Nourishing, healthy, filling food and great vibes.

user_reviews.Name: Yonah Nsiku
user_reviews.Description: The server was extremely kind and showed exceptional hospitality! She even gave us chilled Bissap because it was hot outside! The food was very delicious as well! Highly recommend 👌.

user_reviews.Name: Sym Mendez
user_reviews.Description: I am so glad we found chez Mami! Going to eat there became a regular routine - our trip wouldn't have been the same without this experience! Always a warm welcome, delicious food - whether it was breakfast or lunch- lovely conversation with Mami and her community. She welcomes you in, treats you with kindness and fills your belly and heart. Thank you Mami, looking forward to coming back!

user_reviews.Name: Jean Paul
user_reviews.Description: The food is delicious! Worth every penny!!

user_reviews.Name: Dario Migliorini
user_reviews.Description: If you are a foodie you’re gonna love this place! Fantastic dishes, cooked with love and full of flavor. Definitely a must if you are in Dakar! Plus Mami is super friendly and welcoming 💯

user_reviews.Name: CSW
user_reviews.Description: While travelling in Dakar, I stumbled upon this place, I loved it and I can see why other reviewers do too. This is absolutely where you should grab a cheap local breakfast or lunch in Ouakam. Don’t let the humble setting fool you, the food is wonderful. Mami is a real one, she’s so kind and welcoming, come say hi! She even let us try her home-made hibiscus juice. 11/10.

user_reviews.Name: Patrik Beránek
user_reviews.Description: Super cool lady, super cool place, delicious food. 5*

user_reviews.Name: Ken Ota
user_reviews.Description:
Dishes are so nice, such as thieboujen blanc, yassa poisson, etc. Beyond that, it is Mamie’s hospitality that makes this place so special and always made me feel extremely happy.
During my two-week stay, I really felt Teranga thanks to Mamie. Jerejef!

title: Izakaya dakar
address: Senegal, Dakar, villa 99, Mamelles Izakaya dakar

user_reviews.Name: Rossat Marcel
user_reviews.Description:
What a wonderful experience…

With a group of close friends, we arrived at Izakaya restaurant. A cozy atmosphere and a lovely intimate terrace.

Being used to going out together, as true food lovers, we honestly didn’t pay much attention at first, without expecting too much. We ordered dishes to share and also according to everyone’s preferences… but when the first plates started coming out… what a delight! Carefully prepared cuisine and elegant presentation, each dish is a little adventure… ultra-fresh products, crafted with finesse and subtlety. Simply delicious!

The service team adds that special touch that makes all the difference… attentive and caring! The bill was very reasonable, with an excellent quality-to-price ratio.

In short, a real surprise and a big bravo to the Izakaya team — we had a truly wonderful evening.

Congratulations to Hitomi and her team, we’ll be back soon!

user_reviews.Name: Bailey Hobbs
user_reviews.Description:
On top of yummy food and good drinks the service here is incredible! I don't just mean  good for dakar (the bar is low) but good by all standards.

Great atmosphere too! It's worked for both group happy hours and date night. Satisfied every time.

Amazing addition to the neighborhood.

user_reviews.Name: Carson Brown
user_reviews.Description:
Really delicious! The ramen broth is so perfect and savory, each ingredient is delicious. Also the best bite of sushi in Dakar! I got the shake without cream cheese and it was perfect. (We don’t have cream cheese in sushi in America, and I was always surprised to see it in francophone countries)

It is very clear they put so much care into each ingredient. Even the sesame seeds were beautifully roasted.

The employees are all wonderful and kind. They told me that this place just opened a couple weeks ago as the more “zen” sister restaurant to Matcha Cafe. Perfect for date night, I can’t wait to go back!

user_reviews.Name: Saad M
user_reviews.Description: We came back for a second visit, and it was just as wonderful as the first time! The food was fresh, perfectly prepared, and full of authentic Japanese flavor. The service was warm and attentive, and the atmosphere felt calm and inviting. It’s rare to find a place that is consistently excellent, but this restaurant delivers every time. We’re already looking forward to our next visit!

user_reviews.Name: Ayoub Samadi
user_reviews.Description: Awesome place. It's like a parallel universe in the heart of Ouakam. The service is very clean and friendly. Special thanks to Seigi for making our experience feel warm and hospitable. Definitely coming again!

user_reviews.Name: Sara Sá
user_reviews.Description: Fantastic experience! First time eating at the restaurant (after ordering many times) and we will definitely be back.

user_reviews.Name: aris3ono
user_reviews.Description: It is a nice Japanese restaurant

user_reviews.Name: Joy Jamal Eddine
user_reviews.Description: I walked into this Japanese restaurant in Dakar expecting a simple dinner and ended up having one of my best meals of the year. The sushi was incredibly fresh, the ramen rich and comforting, and every dish felt carefully crafted. The staff were warm, the atmosphere calm, and I left feeling like I’d taken a little trip to Tokyo. A must-try spot — I’m already planning my next visit.

title: La Dolce Vita
address: Route de l'Aereoport (à cote siège Malik Gackou, Dakar 11500, Senegal

complete_address.street: Route de l'Aereoport (à cote siège Malik Gackou

user_reviews.Name: A. SEYE
user_reviews.Description: Mannn… im so happy to have found this place! I ordered a pepperoni pizza, chicken Parmesan pasta, and a Oreo ice cream. Everything 10/10 best pizza I’ve ever had in Dakar!!! Price is reasonable because portion size of good, i had take away boxes!

user_reviews.Name: Helen Wittman
user_reviews.Description: My husband and I are staying in Dakar. We have been to La Dolce Vita several times. Every time we’ve been here, the food has been delicious! The service is prompt, professional, and the servers are kind. We will continue to eat at La Dolce Vita!

user_reviews.Name: Tamer TÜKENMEZ
user_reviews.Description: They make delicious pizzas. The service is decent and the staff are very friendly. However, the restaurant is a bit dark inside. But that's just a minor detail. I really liked it 👍🏻

user_reviews.Name: Jeannine D.
user_reviews.Description:
Dolce Vita is truly a gem. The food was absolutely excellent, and the atmosphere warm and welcoming — just the way a great dining experience should be.
A special mention goes to Momar, who is simply exceptional. He treats every customer like family, going above and beyond to ensure everyone is satisfied. When a dish we wanted wasn't available, he didn’t just apologize — he recommended an alternative, had it specially prepared, and it turned out to be a fantastic choice.
Kudos to Dolce Vita for not only serving great food but for delivering such heartfelt hospitality. I highly recommend this restaurant.

user_reviews.Name: Alphonse Mendy
user_reviews.Description: This is truly a restaurant to get a taste and hospitality of Senegambia. The baobab juice is a must plus the dish/plate of the day.

user_reviews.Name: Simran Grover
user_reviews.Description:
Absolutely amazing food, friendly staff, and great atmosphere. Easily the best pizza place in Dakar and pocket-friendly!
We ordered one veg and two non-veg pizzas and all of them were exceptional. The founder has spent over two decades in Italy and you can experience the authenticity and expertise in their pizzas. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Cherif Ndiaye
user_reviews.Description: Great place to visit while in Dakar. My kids loved the spaghetti and bolognaise. The ice cream and pastries are also delicious. We're going back for their original Italian pizza tomorrow. Check it out!

user_reviews.Name: Puru Verma
user_reviews.Description:
Best pizza in Dakar! The crust is super fluffy and the pizzas have generous toppings!

To top it off the staff is super friendly and service is fast.

Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Juju B
user_reviews.Description: Gorgeous cafe, welcoming staff, and some of the best food I had in Dakar. Seriously, it’s a vibe and enjoyed a beautiful kora performance during one of the brunches. LOVE BAN

user_reviews.Name: Mariel Camargo
user_reviews.Description:
Amazing brunch spot!! I love their concept of a cafe + pottery workshop. I got the fried squid with yuzu sauce (amazing 😍), okra, and morning glory. Definitely recommend, the entire meal was really refreshing and nourishing. I also got the moringa cake with raspberry sorbet & wow- a definite must. It definitely looks as amazing as it tastes. I would hold off on the kombucha next t
Ike though, it wasn’t as carbonated as I expected it to be. They also have free wifi, so it is an amazing place to wfh or just work on any task. Something to keep in mind though is that the dining area is completely outside so it was kind of hot, but it’s well shaded so you aren’t under the sun. Amazing and attentive staff as well. This has been on of my favorite places to eat here in Dakar. 😍

user_reviews.Name: Patience
user_reviews.Description:
The drinks were good and the food had a beautiful presentation, however it was severely under seasoned.

Also, I received food poisoning, it could've been from all of the flies swarming the food.

user_reviews.Name: broucks wright
user_reviews.Description: Pottery workshop run by one sister while the other sister runs the restaurant. Imaginative food well conceived. Highly recommended.

user_reviews.Name: Tal Harris
user_reviews.Description: Wonderful fresh food and atmosphere, vegan options as well

user_reviews.Name: Jan-Paul Bruins
user_reviews.Description: Above and beyond expectations. Creative culinary experience blending traditional ingredients into modern dishes. Not pretentious, just great food and service.

user_reviews.Name: Fabian Heppe
user_reviews.Description: In a bustling city like Dakar, where traffic is heavy and noise is omnipresent, Ban Café stands out as an oasis for those seeking respite. It's a place I always find myself returning to, offering not just good food but also a serene ambiance where one can unwind, engage in friendly conversations with the staff, and rejuvenate. Nestled amidst passion fruit plants, visitors can indulge in delicious, wholesome meals and savor quality coffee at fairly reasonable prices. What sets Ban Café apart is the evident passion and care put into its construction, reflecting in every detail. The staff exudes warmth and hospitality, always willing to engage in a friendly chat. Without a doubt, it's one of my favorite spots in Dakar.

user_reviews.Name: John Hansen
user_reviews.Description: Been here a couple of times because the menu is amazing and absolutely original. The place is also beautiful and relaxed, you can even sit and work and enjoy their good coffee. Even the waitresses are fantastic, so just a wonderful experience.

user_reviews.Name: Aissatou Diop
user_reviews.Description:
I had an online course there, it was calm and peaceful. The food was good and the view was lit.
There is also prayer place in it🥰
But if you're an asthamatic you need to be aware not to stay next to the windows because of people from others restaurant smoking. I end up with an asthma crisis on my way to home due to that😂

user_reviews.Name: Mamadou Gakou
user_reviews.Description:
The best place ever, the food is great, clean, and yummy, the staff were so professional. I loved it . I been there with my wife, it was her birthday, we didnt bring a cake but they provided a cake , sing for her, i was so surprised.
Hey si vous cherchez un endroit ou mangez la bonne nouriture venez ici i love it

user_reviews.Description: C'était magnifique. Très bon restaurant aux almadies. Pour anniversaires, entre amis ou en famille c'est le lieu que je vous recommande

user_reviews.Name: Simon Boulos
user_reviews.Description:
Très bon restaurant en bord de mer.. Les plats sont succulents. Il y a des plats libanais.
Les prix sont abordables.
Très bon accueil: la serveuse Maman était aux petits soins.
Un plus : ouvre tard jusqu'à 1h-2h du matin
2 problèmes majeurs: la musique très forte du "Jungle" mitoyen et pas de vente d'alcool.

user_reviews.Name: Seydou Camara
user_reviews.Description: On a pris un cocktail et chicha à roc à marin aux Almadies. Nous avons regardé le match et on a aimé la disposition avec la vue sur la mer. C’est magnifique je vous suggère vivement ce restaurant

user_reviews.Name: Aleksandra Sushko
user_reviews.Description: I got the Senegalese brunch - the portion was so so generous I took it home and it was my dinner as well :) The food was just so yummy and the service was wonderful. Thank you!

user_reviews.Name: George Casper
user_reviews.Description: Incredible food. Great service. Nice aesthetic. The chicken and waffles were amazing!!

user_reviews.Name: Asia Leeds
user_reviews.Description: As a person from the U.S. South living in Dakar, Mawa’s offers comforting dishes that remind me of home. The biscuits, grits, gravy, fried fish, chicken fried steak, etc are cooked to perfection and virtually impossible to find anywhere else in this city. Beyond the excellent food, the service is impeccable and the servers and manager are super nice and very welcoming. I love that in addition to soul food options, they also serve Mexican and Senegalese dishes and a great variety of juices, smoothies, and coffee.

user_reviews.Name: Jean and Martin Choi
user_reviews.Description: We are so happy Mawa’s has opened its new location in Mamelles! Delicious American & Senegalese cuisine. The staff are friendly and helpful, speaking English, French, and Wolof. They just opened for two weeks, and currently the hours of operation are 11am-4pm. They hope to extend the hours soon once more people come to eat.

user_reviews.Name: Seydou Soumare
user_reviews.Description:
At home atmosphere with various delightful homemade food with great taste, quality and quantity.
Came for brunch but left with a full stomach and satisfied appetite enough to skip lunch.
The service is very attentive and caring at the image of Mawa the owner.
Will return to explore and enjoy more options on the menu, especially the local and traditional meals.

user_reviews.Name: armani hunter
user_reviews.Description:
Single best tasting(can’t speak on health😅) consistent restaurant in Senegal.
Point. Blank. Period.

user_reviews.Name: Chika Oduah
user_reviews.Description: As someone who was raised in the American South, I come Mawa's when I'm craving some good, heavy American food. The biscuits here are very nice. Good salads, too!  Welcoming environment. Pleasant waiters.

user_reviews.Name: Серикбай

MUST TRY!

user_reviews.Description: Une oasis de convivialité autour de plats délicieux Sénégalais. Ouseynou, Sophie et leurs filles vous accueillent comme des ami.es pour un petit moment chaleureux. Ils proposent aussi des verres d'eau Kirene pour à 100 CFA pour les toubabs!

user_reviews.Description: Very little nice local restaurant! Just went inside and asked for a thieboudienne. After 2 minutes I had my hot delicious meal! For just 1000 cfa (as it should be). Friendly woman :)

Ate here twice on a short stay in Dakar, as it was close to my B&B.

Chicken tenders were fresh, classic burger really tasty and good fries. All served with lovely Senegalese smiles, merci à tous 😄

user_reviews.Name: Aleksandra Sushko
user_reviews.Description:
This is the third time I am getting food from Olaf (first time I ordered and the delivery was smooth, the other two times I came myself to pick up).

The food is AMAZING, very yummy, and the people working here are very sweet and energetic.

Keep in mind that this is a take-out place rather than a sit-in restaurant (but they have chairs for you to wait for the food while you’re waiting!). Highly recommend!! :)

user_reviews.Name: Daniel Smith
user_reviews.Description:
As a traveller, a poet, and a devoted connoisseur of the noble art of fried chicken wings, with one hand on my heart and a tear in each eye… I can say, truly, that the wings I tasted today were the finest ever to grace my humble plate.

Thank you for bringing true joy and delight.

Merci x

user_reviews.Name: Carson Brown
user_reviews.Description:
Really nice! They fry the frites and tenders fresh for you. The house seasoning on the fries is yummy, and it comes with three sauces, including piment. The tenders are kind of skinny, which I like because they’re crispy, and they have the slightest kick to them, which is yummy.

Fatou is really nice and very professional!

They do take out and delivery, so you can order through Yango/whatsapp I think, but I walked right up to the door

user_reviews.Name: Jean and Martin Choi
user_reviews.Description: This is our go to chicken wing place! The chicken is crispy and juicy, it’s delicious. And the price is reasonable. What we are even more happy about is that even with our broken French, the customer service is awesome. They always respond quickly and are professional and efficient. The delivery usually arrives between 30-45minutes. The delivery guys do a great job finding our address via Google maps. This is a very good thing. We are repeat customers!

user_reviews.Name: Oulimata Gueye
user_reviews.Description: It was an online order but absolutely loved how my order was handled. Professionalism, speed, flexibility and most of all, delicious !! Keep it up.

user_reviews.Name: Asia Leeds
user_reviews.Description: Love this place! The food is always delicious and fresh, communication is easy, and delivery is quick. This is my go-to for fast food delivery.

user_reviews.Name: Sabrina Nachbaur
user_reviews.Description: I orderd food and it was surprisingly really good. The driver even found the no name road.

user_reviews.Name: Yann Sang
user_reviews.Description: Un très bon restaurant pour un repas rapide. Le plat du jour: demi poulet avec des frites 2500 CFA,  un quart poulet avec des frites 1500 CFA. très bon choix pour les gens qui travaillent et habitent à côté. le poulet est de bonne qualité et je recommande fortement

user_reviews.Name: Sofiane Touré
user_reviews.Description: Les burgers et les sandwichs sont top, après avoir testé pas mal de burgers à dakar,  je met kemet dans mon top 3 sans hésitation. Rapport qualité prix imbattable, 3000fcfa burger gourmet +frites +boisson. Adeptes de burgers, ne passez pas à côté!!

title: BOMA Restaurant & Club
address: QF2W+5J4 BOMA Restaurant & Club, Dakar, Senegal

user_reviews.Name: Adam Bycroft
user_reviews.Description: Best breakfast in Dakar for sure.  The team are very attentive and focussed on customer service.  The food is excellent

user_reviews.Name: Nomad USA
user_reviews.Description:
Visited Boma again for a celebratory dinner with the family the other day. Usually I just walk in and sit. Some random unpolished French National captures us and tells us we can’t go to the pool area to eat. Totally a surprise. I’ve been at Boma several times, never seen this guy there. In fact I have never seen a Maître d' there before. Usually I have to seat myself   I guess it’s an upgrade but he said we weren’t allowed to sit poolside, which was somewhat discouraging. Apparently there was a private affair, however I saw maybe one family sitting there by the pool and a couple of kids in the pool. My daughter brought her swim suit and really wanted a quick dip. But no luck that day, despite most of the tables in the patio being free. I didn’t see a party going on. So we were escorted to a dark, un air conditioned area inside the main room.  After sweating a bit I had to ask if they could turn on the A/C.
Super happy they did finally.
It was about 5 pm and happy hour just kicked in.  No one was on the restaurant. Staff and service is generally cool there. Somewhat pensive. One waitress repeated out our orders several times. But still got some of it wrong. I ordered puree potato’s with my Tomahawk Steak (which I wont order again), and I got Mexican potatoes. The fries my kids ordered with their steaks seem to be warmed up from a bag of frozen ones. The Lamb Tangine I’m told was very good. We ordered 2 of these.  But for 13000 cfa, it seemed a bit small. The tomahawk steak was big and for the most part really. tasty, with hints of Worcestershire  and ginger, for 21,000 cfa. But much of it I could not eat. Big  chunks of cartilage, and some parts were really tough, I could not cut the meat from the bone. They gave me a super ineffective cheap tiny “steak knife” to cut this massive tomahawk
It was useless. I had my own Laguiole I pulled out to cut this thing. Ate most of the steak and  took home the rest to finish off later. But the next day it was super tough. The other two regular steaks, fillet de boeuf,  were good. My kids finished them off pretty fast. Ordered a Cabernet Sauvignon. We got a Chardonnay or something. Sent it back. I heard the bartender say he did not know the difference in wines, what a Cabernet is vs white wine. I also ordered a couple of margaritas. They were ok but inconsistant. One had Salt, one had no salt. One tasted virgin, no tequila in it. By the time the second margarita arrived, dinner was over so I didn’t ask if it was virgin or not. Ordered two of the Gao Bao porc. That was very good. So the service was ok. Several servers came by a couple of times But I’m still bugged about the maître d’ who I never saw again. You’d figure after spending over 125,000 CFA the guy would come over and ask how the meal was. The couple of times I got a free Panna Cotta and a limoncello after the meal. Maybe he didn’t work there and just wanted us away from the pool ?

user_reviews.Name: Vicky Stephens
user_reviews.Description: Such a beautiful space. Affordable and delicious food. The Poulet Yassa was a bit too sweet for me but I like the pain perdu.

user_reviews.Name: Geoff Power
user_reviews.Description: Here for an event...Superb location,  if you or your business is having an event. Exolore Boma as it does not dissapoint. Staff and ownership make sure all goes well..

user_reviews.Name: Eva Angel
user_reviews.Description: Had a great time, the service is extremely wonderful and the atmosphere is great. Thanks so much BOMA for the great hospitality.

user_reviews.Name: David Dwi Santoso
user_reviews.Description: They have a great place and so Instagrammable. The food are delicious with big portion, I love it.

user_reviews.Name: Aminata Ka
user_reviews.Description: This place is great for date night with your significant other,  specially you are a steak fan like me. For the quality of food, the prices are very reasonable.

user_reviews.Name: Jimi Oke
user_reviews.Description:
Food was lovely.

However wouldn’t expect good treatment if you’re not French or are a black person. I was ignored by the restaurant manager and staff when I entered. I found my own seat and after 15 minutes of being seated, I still had to go and request a Menu and asked on how I order.

I saw other French expats come in, be greeted offered menus and taken to their seats with smiles. This ruined the experience for me.

user_reviews.Name: Tiphaine Hocquemiller
user_reviews.Description:
Un immense merci pour votre prestation lors du baptême de notre fille !
Du poisson au poulet braisé, en passant par le tieboudienne et le poulet frit, tout était délicieux et en quantité plus que généreuse (personne n’est reparti avec faim 😉). On avait même beaucoup de restes.

Service au top, équipe réactive, professionnelle et parfaitement à l’heure. Vous avez grandement contribué à la réussite de cette belle journée — on recommande les yeux fermés ! ✨

user_reviews.Name: Angele MESSA
user_reviews.Description: Calm and beautiful space for a cozy and beautiful moment. Took my dad out for dinner at sunset. He loved it. I went for the paella and it was really good and the strong waves was like song in our ears. Try the fondant as dessert

user_reviews.Name: Empress Carter
user_reviews.Description: This is a beautiful restaurant. Great location. Gorgeous scenery. Hospitable service. Great food. This is where I experienced Senegalese Téranga hospitality and authentic Senegalese food. I highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Leah
user_reviews.Description: Lovely spot on the water. The food was fresh and the menu was diverse. I had the chef special which was a fun local dish and my friend had a fish sandwich which she said was fine. The breeze off the ocean was lovely.

user_reviews.Name: Katy Wheelock
user_reviews.Description: I've been bringing groups of up to 20 Americans and Canadians here for dinner. It's a beautiful view at night of the Monument de la Renaissance and the Phare, We work with the restaurant in advance to create a menu that meets the dietary needs and restrictions of the group. Usually they give us too much food! But it is tasty and appreciated. It is lovely dining with the sound of waves crashing right next to the restuarant.

user_reviews.Name: Chop Stay Love
user_reviews.Description:
I came to Chez Fatou hoping to try the thieboudienne, but they didn’t have it that day. I went with the staff’s recommendation of thiof instead—and it was absolutely delicious. Generous portion, the fish was full of flavour and so satisfying I couldn’t finish it. Took the rest home and enjoyed it again the next day!

The atmosphere was quiet and peaceful, with soft music playing in the background—perfect for a relaxing dinner by the sea. The service was attentive, and while it’s on the pricier side, the quality of the experience made it feel worth it.

user_reviews.Name: giulio galante
user_reviews.Description: Nice view on the shore. A part this the food is ok but not spectacular, staff was kind but had to ask the supervisor any simple question (like what kind of wine do you serve by glass) and they didn’t accept credit or debit cards just cash or mobile money

user_reviews.Name: Miguel Benjamin Bityeki Mbamba
user_reviews.Description:

Really nice spot for a good lunch or dinner with friends, family or colleagues.

user_reviews.Name: Esayas Girmay
user_reviews.Description: Beautiful place in Almadie right at the corniche beach. Good choice of food, not very tasty though. We had grillee fish and beef fillet. The atmosphere is tranquille. Would go again.

user_reviews.Name: Bar Dado
user_reviews.Description: Magic atmosphere, nice girls at the counter. We had pizza, not bad at all. Recommended for its position facing the ocean. Incredible sunset.

user_reviews.Name: María Camila Casadiego
user_reviews.Description: My favorite spot in Dakar by far! I come here at least 3 times a week when I’m here for work. Casa Teranga is a peaceful escape from the busy Almadies area — calm vibes, ocean sounds, and vibrant decor. The food is such a highlight: fresh, flavorful, colorful and perfect for vegans (which is rare in Dakar). Bowls are always nourishing and made fresh, you can literally taste the care that goes into each dish. Staff are super friendly and respectful. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Say
user_reviews.Description: The food and smoothies are absolutely delicious. The staff are friendly and were very patient with my limited French. And the view just can't be beat

user_reviews.Name: Alessio
user_reviews.Description:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ A Heavenly Experience: A Vegan, Super Healthy, and Sugar-Free Paradise!

As a lover of healthy and vegan cuisine, I can say without hesitation that this restaurant is a hidden gem! From the moment you step inside, you are welcomed by a relaxing atmosphere and an aroma that promises a truly unique culinary experience.

The menu is a symphony of flavors, perfectly balancing taste and health. Every dish is a work of art, showcasing the freshest ingredients and surprising combinations that demonstrate a genuine love for vegan cooking. And knowing that everything is completely sugar-free is just the cherry on top (of course, a healthy and delicious cherry!).

We tried several dishes, and each one amazed us with its deliciousness—from the vibrant, nutrient-packed bowls to the light yet incredibly indulgent desserts. Every bite was a sensory journey that delighted the palate without any guilt.

The staff was fantastic: attentive, knowledgeable, and always ready to explain every detail of the dish with passion and expertise. You can truly feel the commitment to creating not just a gastronomic experience but an emotional one that leaves you with a profound sense of well-being.

I recommend this place to anyone who wants to nourish their body and soul, whether you are vegan or just curious to explore healthy and authentic cuisine. A true oasis of health and happiness!

user_reviews.Name: Rj (Jake)
user_reviews.Description:
The owner is very friendly and I like his story about his restaurant “Berlin to Dakar”.

Every dishes is very colorful visually and flavorful.

I really enjoy the sunset view and the cold breeze of the sea.

Definitely will recommend and come back again.

user_reviews.Name: Briana H.
user_reviews.Description:
The food and drinks were absolutely amazing. The only and biggest issue was the very large amount of flies in the dining area. I visited around 3:45pm. I wasn't able to enjoy everything at a slow and steady pace and take in all of the amazing flavors because I did not want to have to keep an eye out for the flies. I am told that this may be normal for Dakar, but if you are not used to it, it may be unnerving. It may be helpful if there are maybe those small table fans for guests. Or maybe a quick wipe down just before guests sit with some sort of natural bug repellent like a diluted essential oil (eucalyptus, peppermint, etc.)

Again, great food and drinks (the dessert was amazing), just way too many flies during the afternoon. I love the idea of the restaurant. I would try again maybe in the evening if there are less flies.

user_reviews.Name: Jondis Schwartzkopff
user_reviews.Description: This place is a gem 🍀💚 We had the Jollof and Ashtanga dishes - delicious and beautifully plated food! Plus local juices/smoothies, and real Italian coffee. Of course with European price for a very special experience. The place is really beautifully decorated and has fantastic views. The owner lives in Berlin and Dakar, the cuisine is Senegalese/Italian and the whole place is 100% vegan and waste free, according to the owner unique in West Africa :) Very friendly vibes, would definitely come back and really recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Dyan Barutzki
user_reviews.Description: Great Local food! Got by with my little knowledge of French. Lovely owner. Went around 18:30. Not sure what to order, but they recommended - settled for a Chicken in tomato sauce dish with rice. Popular with the locals! Price range 5,000 - 10,000 XOF

user_reviews.Name: Tony AA
user_reviews.Description: Very clean and serves traditional Senegalese and Ivorian cuisine.. The service was great and the location is a big plus. Great for daily lunch orders. Service is very rapidly. Made. The pricing is not bad as well. Very easy to reach from anywhere on Almadies and security is also some what assured. Adequate parking as well.

user_reviews.Name: Deguene Fall
user_reviews.Description: I have gone there several time for lunch. Never tried the dinner menu. The Ivorian dishes are delicious. The service is very good and prices are also reasonable. The owner is always there and ready to help.  Just wished the place was more airy.

user_reviews.Name: Allan Stockman Rugano
user_reviews.Description: The best restaurants for African food in Dakar. Their sauce feuilles and different meals are tailored for the taste of different peoples. They make delivery and the prices are really affordable. On Friday, they make Senegalese dishes.

user_reviews.Name: Amanda Weilenmann
user_reviews.Description:
As far as I understand this place only takes online orders - you can't eat here. We ordered meals from them at least twice because they were so delicious. The portions are very big and the price is very affordable.

I would definitely recommend the Thiebu Diene and the Yassa chicken. The thiebu diene had all the incredible ingredients and was flavourful and just so different and awesome. The chicken was cooked so nicely with excellent smokey flavor and the onions were really lemony with a hint of olive. The maffe was also nice. The order came quickly and they also communicate with you over WhatsApp. It was a really great experience and I would definitely recommend ordering authentic Senegalese food from here.

user_reviews.Description:
L'accueil était chaleureux dès notre arrivée, et l'atmosphère du lieu est très agréable, à la fois moderne et cosy. Le service était rapide et attentif, ce qui a vraiment amélioré l'expérience.

La nourriture était un véritable délice ! Les plats étaient savoureux, bien présentés et préparés avec des ingrédients frais.

Le rapport qualité-prix est très bon, et je reviendrai sans hésiter. Un endroit à découvrir absolument pour les amateurs de bonne cuisine !
